jobs.jd:
Are you passionate about the systems that keep Amazon Air's aircraft loaded safely, on schedule, and in balance — every flight, every day? Do you want to build the platforms that load planners, ramp operators, and third-party carriers depend on to move Amazon's freight through the air?

This role is an SDE-II position on Amazon Air's Safety Tech team within the Air Optimization Tech organization — the team that builds and operates the load-planning, weight-and-balance, verification, and scale-integration systems for Amazon Air. You will be a hands-on builder on a Tier-1 safety-critical portfolio spanning SABLE (load planning and W&B), Diesel Service, Auto Load Verification (RLVS/ALV), the Digital Scale Log, and Centralized Load Planning (CLP) Tools.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test, deploy, and operate services within Safety Tech's Tier-1 portfolio (SABLE ecosystem, Diesel, RLVS/ALV, Digital Scale Log, CLP) — writing production-quality code and owning your services end-to-end.
- Lead the delivery of medium-to-large features across the SDLC — decomposing an ambiguous problem into a phased design, driving code reviews, shepherding launches through gamma → prod, and validating recovery with customers.
- Contribute to design and architecture reviews for distributed systems, event-driven messaging (SNS/SQS), and AWS-native services (Lambda, AppStream, Cognito, CDK, CloudWatch, DynamoDB). Push back on designs when reliability, observability, or blast radius are not adequately handled.
- Own operational excellence for a 24×7, globally deployed safety-critical portfolio — build alarms and dashboards, participate in on-call rotations, drive COEs and action items to closure, and improve availability, latency, and disaster-recovery posture across NA and EU.
- Drive PEAK / PTR / LTRA readiness for Tier-1 services (SABLE and dependents): close PE risks, hit resiliency-score targets, complete LTRA documentation, and land the underlying engineering work on the REALM/TTS timeline.
- Land key deliverables within major initiatives — CLP, Diesel, RLVS/ALV, and Fly LP — collaborating with adjacent AOT tools, IAL, 3P carrier partners, and airline operations.
- Contribute to the SABLE integration surface, IAL Fly Portal, and 3P access model (Cognito user pools, LDAP groups, Gateway permissions) — including 3P onboarding and the BB/3P permissions workflow.
- Rationalize and modernize the legacy SABLE Proxy stack and Message Transformers where appropriate, and drive convergence with adjacent AirTech FLYGO systems.
- Mentor junior engineers, raise the bar on code and design reviews, and represent Safety Tech in cross-team technical discussions.

About the team
Safety Tech owns the systems that ensure every Amazon Air aircraft is loaded within its weight-and-balance envelope, that hazardous goods are correctly declared to the captain, and that load plans move accurately between Amazon systems, third-party ground handlers, and airline operations. Our platform is used at both Amazon blue-badge gateways and 3P sites globally, in NA and EU, across Amazon-run and partner-operated ramps.

You will own your slice of that portfolio end-to-end: durable, auditable, always-on systems for a domain where safety is non-negotiable.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS DynamoDB
jobs.jd:
Amazon DynamoDB powers many of the world's fastest-growing businesses, including Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin. It also powers enterprises such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One. Within Amazon, it runs high-traffic properties including Alexa, Amazon.com, and every Amazon fulfillment center. DynamoDB is one of the largest distributed database systems in the world. We believe it is always Day 1, and we keep improving the service and adding new capabilities.

DynamoDB is a serverless, fully managed database. It delivers consistent single-digit millisecond performance at any scale, with no servers to provision, no maintenance windows, and no downtime. Customers can create a table and scale it automatically to their most demanding workloads without having to plan capacity. During Prime Day 2026, DynamoDB handled more than 59 trillion requests over four days. It peaked at 192 million requests per second while keeping single-digit millisecond response times. The Capacity & Customer Entitlement (CCE) team builds the systems behind this. We decide how much throughput and storage each customer gets and enforce quotas and limits fairly. We also keep DynamoDB's global fleet ahead of demand. When our systems do their job, customers grow without thinking about capacity, and DynamoDB runs efficiently at any scale.

Managing capacity for one of the largest databases in the world is a hard distributed systems problem. Our systems forecast demand across every AWS Region, plan and place capacity across the fleet, and manage the limits and entitlements that decide how far each customer can scale. We prepare DynamoDB for major events such as Prime Day and new Region launches, so capacity is in place well before customers need it. We are building fully automated capacity management from the ground up. It is a greenfield opportunity to design systems that detect, predict, and act on their own. Engineers on this team solve problems where accuracy, scale, and cost all matter at the same time, and their work shapes how customers experience DynamoDB.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate the services that manage DynamoDB throughput, storage, quotas, and customer entitlements at global scale.
- Build automated capacity management: demand forecasting, proactive scaling, and self-healing workflows that replace manual operations.
- Build APIs and data platforms, that give DynamoDB teams and tools accurate, real-time views of capacity and usage.
- Reduce throttling, speed up limit increases, and make large-scale fleet events safe and predictable.

jobs.location: AU: Sydney (45 Clarence St) | Sydney, Australia
jobs.jd:
The role / impact

Every team at Xero has work that is slow, manual and error prone and the people doing it are often the ones best placed to make better decisions if they had time. We're building agentic AI workflows/agents that take that toil away, so our people can focus on the work that matters. 

The internal AI accelerator squad partners directly with Xero's enterprise and G&A functions, including HR, Legal, Finance, Sales teams. As a Senior Engineer, you will work in a forward deployed way, sitting down with senior business leaders to understand their challenges, then designing, building and delivering agents and workflows that the business can run itself. You will own that work end to end, from the first conversation to a live system with real users. 

The technical challenges: 

The Squad is early in it's life and the problems are as much about judgement as engineering. Five problems define the work: 

 - Agents the business trusts: Build agentic workflows that handle real work, with human review, guardrails and clear escalation, so business teams are comfortable relying on them.

 - Discovery to delivery: Take an ambiguous business pain point, shape it into a problem worth solving, and deliver a working solution quickly, then iterate with the people using it.

 - Production, not prototypes: Design agents that are observable, evaluated and maintainable, with evals, monitoring and cost controls built in from the start.

 - Handover that sticks: Build so the business team can own and run the outcome without you in the loop, and so the next agent is faster to build than the last.

 - Platforms that scale us: Build the golden paths, MCP integrations and reusable skills that let hundreds of Xeros build and ship AI safely, without needing an engineer for every idea. 

What we build: 

 - Agents in production: triage agents for IT and People support, an onboarding orchestrator that guides every new starter, tax classification, and spend limit approval automation that cut approvals from hours to seconds. 

 - Platforms that scale AI across Xero: the Dashboard Accelerator, which takes apps people build in Claude to secure internal hosting in minutes instead of weeks; a governed marketplace for Claude plugins and skills; and support for a growing community of citizen builders. 

 - MCP and enterprise integrations: production grade MCP servers that safely connect agents to systems like Workday and Salesforce, plus the patterns and guidance the rest of Xero builds on. 

 - Bonus: experience building MCP servers, durable workflows (e.g. Temporal), or agent frameworks such as Pydantic AI or LangGraph. 

Tools and Tech: 

You'll get early access to the latest AI tooling (Claude Code, Glean, Gemini, GitHub Copilot and many models through our AI gateway) and the freedom to choose the right tool for the job. Today we build Python, Typescript and .NET; MCP;Temporal; AWS, Kubernetes and Terraform; Snowflake and ddbt; and GitHub Actions. 

Your job is to keep adding to that list, with each workflow sharper and more reusable than the one before. 

Impact: 

 - First 6 months: You'll understand the squad's platform, patterns and stakeholders. You'll be building alongside the team and have one agentic workflow in discovery or build with a senior business partner, with a clear scope and success measures agreed up front.

 - First 12 months: You'll have delivered at least one agentic workflow into production that a business team uses day to day, with evals and monitoring in place. You'll have handed it over so the business runs it, and your learnings will be feeding back into the squad's shared patterns and tooling. You will have also built a strong rapport with the business function you are working with, being the trusted technical expert for all things AI and contributed to the squads shared platforms, integrations or tooling. 

What You Bring

 - Software engineering fundamentals, with experience designing and building reliable services and APIs

 - Experience delivering agentic AI or LLM workflows into real production use, not just prototypes or personal projects

 - Experience owning a relationship with senior non-technical stakeholders: understanding their pain point, building a solution, and handing it over so they run it without you

 - Experience designing agentic systems with tool use, retrieval, human-in-the-loop controls and guardrails, and evaluating them with measurable quality criteria

 - The ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical leaders and build trust through delivery

 - Comfort using AI tools to improve how you build, with judgement about when and how to validate their output

How We Work

We're bold in our vision and pragmatic in execution. We deliver useful improvements early and often, and we invest in AI to learn faster and focus effort on higher value problems. Engineers stay accountable for what they ship, including quality and reliability. We use shared frameworks to avoid reinvention, leaving teams room to innovate. Leaders set context and priorities, and engineers help shape the solutions.

Where we work: 

We offer a hybrid model that blends the flexibility of working from home with the collaboration of the office including designated boost days in our office spaces. 

Our hiring process: 

 1. TX phone screen (45 minutes): a conversation with your Talent Specialist about your background, motivations and the role.

 2. Round 1: (60 minutes) A technical conversation with Senior Engineers on this team, where you'll walk through an agentic workflow you've delivered, from the business problem to production and core engineering technical questions

 3. Round 2: (60 minutes) A conversation focused on how you work with stakeholders and show up against Xero's values, including ownership, customer thinking and AI fluency.

If this sounds like the role you are looking for, hit the apply button!

SENIOR ENGINEER - PLATFORM

The role and its impact

As a Senior Engineer in our Infrastructure team, you’ll help Xero engineers build and test software faster and with more confidence. You’ll design and build the systems that create test environments, and you’ll make sure test data is ready when teams need it. This work sits at the heart of how we ship software, and it helps set Xero up for AI transformation.

You’ll work across complex platforms, including older legacy systems alongside modern technology. There will be trade-offs to weigh as you decide where the most value sits for engineering teams. Xero asks you to Go Bold in how you approach these problems, and to Go Fast without cutting corners.

The team and how they connect

Our Infrastructure team builds the platform foundations that Xero engineers rely on every day. Our engineers come from software, platform and infrastructure backgrounds, and we work closely with teams across Xero to understand their systems and find elegant solutions. We believe in Going Together, which means sharing knowledge openly and making sure everyone’s voice is heard.

The team is currently working on / Initially, you will focus on:

 - Building support systems and tooling for test environments, so engineers can test changes without waiting on blockers.

 - Improving test data and enabling frictionless testing across engineering teams.

 - Working with our Golang services, alongside infrastructure built with Terraform on AWS, including Kubernetes, EC2 and Lambda.

Where and how you can work

 - Your background could be in software engineering that has moved into platform or DevOps, or in infrastructure work that understands how software is built.

 - Golang is our preferred language, though strong experience in Java or .NET is equally welcome.

 - Hands-on experience with Terraform, AWS and Kubernetes will help you hit the ground running.

 - A curious, problem-solving mindset and the ability to pick up unfamiliar systems quickly, including legacy ones, are key to how you’ll Go Further here.

 - Clear communication is second nature to you, whether you’re working in another team’s codebase or presenting to leadership.

Apply even if your experience isn’t a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

jobs.jd:
Do you want to build the system that tells millions of engineers the moment something goes wrong? As a Software Development Engineer on Amazon CloudWatch Alarms, you will design and operate the service that continuously evaluates customer metrics and logs, and acts on them in real time — notifying on-call teams, scaling fleets, and recovering resources, often while the rest of a customer's infrastructure is under stress. When our customers have an incident, our alarms have to be right and on time — that is the problem you will work on every day.

CloudWatch is the observability service of Amazon Web Services (AWS), used by developers, site reliability engineers (SREs), system operators, and IT managers to monitor their applications and infrastructure. CloudWatch processes quadrillions of metric observations every month and continuosly evaluates millions of alarms, with tight latency and correctness requirements.

This role is based in Dublin, Ireland.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Design, build and operate highly available distributed systems that evaluate customer alarms and trigger notifications and automated actions across AWS.

Deliver new alarming capabilities — from composite alarms to anomaly detection — from design through launch in every AWS Region.

Dive deep into operational issues, identify root causes, and put fixes in place that prevent them from recurring.

Collaborate with partner teams across CloudWatch and AWS to turn customer requirements into designs and incremental, safe deliverables.

Mentor junior engineers and share what you learn through design and code reviews.

A day in the life
You might start the day investigating why a customer's alarm changed state later than expected, then join a design review for a new capability that lets customers monitor thousands of resources with a single alarm. In the afternoon, you could profile the evaluation path to cut latency and cost. AI coding assistants and agents are part of how you work every day — you'll use them to explore unfamiliar code, prototype ideas, write tests, and speed up investigations, freeing up more of your time for design and hard problems.

This role includes participating in an on-call rotation for the services the team owns. We don't like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we build our systems to be fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so we don't get paged for the same issue twice.

About the team
CloudWatch Alarms is how AWS customers learn that something needs their attention. Our customers range from startups to the largest enterprises, and teams across Amazon rely on our alarms to keep their own services healthy. Our vision is for every alarm to be timely, accurate and actionable at any scale. Over the next few years we're focused on making alarms easier to set up across large, changing environments and smarter about what truly needs a human's attention — and you will help shape that roadmap.

Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we've built an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior engineers enjoy mentoring engineers at every stage, including those from non-traditional backgrounds, through one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews.  Job Category 
Customer Success 
 Job Details 
 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

 The Experience 

As a Data360 (formerly known as Data Cloud) Success Architect, you will play a crucial role in driving successful outcomes for our strategic customers by leveraging your technical expertise in data and analytics. Your guidance will directly influence the technical architecture, performance optimization, and solution design strategies for our strategic customers.

Data360 supports seamless integration with Salesforce Marketing, Sales, and Service Clouds, enabling Customer 360 use cases. It helps businesses unify customer data across all touch points, enhancing AI-driven marketing automation, personalized engagement, and predictive customer insights.

Data360 is the foundation of Agentforce, enabling real-time, intelligent decision-making by centralizing and harmonizing enterprise data. You will collaborate with customers, colleagues, and partners to evaluate technical architecture, optimize performance, and design effective solutions.

This role is office-flexible, and the expectation is to work from the office three days per week.

 What You'll Actually Be Doing 

- Be a trusted Agentforce + Data360 subject-matter expert for the broader Success Architect organization, including how Data360 relates to the success of AI, and drive thought leadership through mentoring and knowledge sharing 

- Engage with our Signature and Strategic customers to evaluate and recommend optimization strategies for technical architecture, dev/ops, performance, and solution design specific to Agentforce + Data360 

- Identify and evaluate capability gaps for standard product capability or identify creative Architect solutions through customization 

- Facilitate and influence Executive stakeholders while aligning technology strategy to business value and ROI, run playbooks aligned with our Success Architect engagement catalog, and build strong relationships with internal and external business partners 

 You're Our Person If... 

- Minimum 5 years proven experience in enterprise consulting, including implementing enterprise software solutions in the Analytics/CDP spaces, and the ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes focusing on data & integration architecture, including guiding customers through migration to and optimization of Agentforce + Data360 

- Deep understanding of data modeling, integration architectures, and data governance best practices, with excellent communication skills and the ability to facilitate discussions and translate technical concepts into tangible business value and ROI from Developer to Executive 

- Proactive and self-starting attitude, able to manage tasks independently while collaborating remotely, stay up-to-date with emerging data-related and AI technologies, and ensure customer solutions adhere to data security and privacy regulations and best practices 

- Degree or equivalent experience required. Experience evaluated based on the strengths you'll need for the role (e.g. proven behaviors in previous jobs such as extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.). Must be a US Citizen 

 Even Better If... 

- Minimum 2 development/project implementation lifecycles of Salesforce Data360/CDP + AI, and experience in a consulting and implementation Partner for Data360/CDP 

- Experience with large data such as Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud Storage/Big Query, Azure administration or architecture 

- Experience with Customer Data platforms such as Segment, Tealium, Adobe Experience Platform, Amperity, Treasure Data, Twilio Segment, Realtio, etc, and implementing Salesforce Clouds and multi-cloud scenarios (Sales, Service, Industries, Marketing or Commerce) 

- Familiar with at least one of the Salesforce Architecture Domains (Integration, Access and Identity Management, Data Architecture, Sharing and Visibility, Declarative and APEX Development) and experience in programming languages such as Python, Java, .Net, SQL 

 Unleash Your Potential

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer - Vice President
jobs.jd:
Job Description 
 Citi is looking for a hands on Senior AI Engineer the engineering foundation of its Services AI Platform a multi-tenant, production-grade ecosystem where agentic AI meets enterprise scale. In this player-coach role, you will write production code and set the technical direction for the platform, ensuring it is built on principles of trust, operational resilience, and scalability. You will translate complex enterprise workflows into intelligent, automated systems that deliver measurable business impact across Citi's global operations. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 
- Architect and build full-stack AI platform components using Python and Angular, including internal large language model fine-tuning interfaces and experiment tracking dashboards. 

- Design and optimize multi-tenant intelligent agents using modular orchestration patterns — including ReAct and ReWOO — to power scalable, production-ready agentic workflows. 

- Build Model Context Protocol servers that enforce clean, decoupled communication layers, ensuring agents interact exclusively through defined API boundaries without direct database access. 

- Develop next-generation retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, including Knowledge Graph RAG, LightRAG, and RAPTOR hierarchical summary architectures, to enable sophisticated enterprise data retrieval. 

- Integrate vector and graph databases — such as Neo4j and pgvector — to support complex, thematic data retrieval at platform scale. 

- Design precise prompt and intent classification logic that prevents workflow collisions and ensures each agent instruction is handled with high accuracy. 

- Partner directly with subject matter experts to translate deep domain knowledge into automated, agent-driven solutions, and collaborate with UI and API teams to deliver seamless end-to-end integrations. 
 
 Required Qualifications & Skills 
 
- 10 or more years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years focused on AI and machine learning solutions delivered in production environments. 

- 2 or more years of hands-on experience in Generative AI, including large language model development, retrieval-augmented generation, and prompt engineering. 

- 3 or more years leading technical teams and owning delivery of complex software or AI platforms end to end. 

- Deep practical experience with AWS infrastructure and services for AI and machine learning workloads. 

- A demonstrated portfolio of AI solutions successfully deployed into live business environments, evidencing both technical depth and delivery ownership. 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related field. 
 
 Education 
 
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related field 
 
 What We Offer 
 
 At Citi, you will work at the forefront of enterprise AI engineering within a global platform team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and meaningful business impact. This is a role where your code ships to production, your architectural decisions shape the platform, and your leadership directly influences the capability and performance of the team around you. 
 
- Hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, giving you structure alongside genuine flexibility. 

- Access to cutting-edge AI infrastructure, tools, and frameworks that keep you at the leading edge of the field. 

- Continuous learning and development support, including access to technical training, industry conferences, and structured career growth pathways. 

- The opportunity to lead high-impact engineering at global scale, with your work directly influencing how Citi builds and deploys intelligent automation across the enterprise. 

- Competitive compensation and a comprehensive financial wellbeing package reflective of a Vice President-level position at a leading global institution. 

- Wellbeing support programs that help you maintain balance and perform at your best over the long term. 
 
 Build the AI platform that powers Citi's next generation of intelligent automation — apply now and bring your engineering leadership to one of the most technically ambitious platforms in global financial services

jobs.jd:
Be an integral part of an agile team that's constantly pushing the envelope to enhance, build, and deliver top-notch technology products. 
 As a Senior Lead eSoftware Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within our FICC eTrading team, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. Drive significant business impact through your capabilities and contributions, and apply deep technical expertise and problem-solving methodologies to tackle a diverse array of challenges that span multiple technologies and applications. 
 We’re hiring a Senior UI Developer to build the next generation of FICC eTrading applications. Work directly with traders on high-performance, low-latency interfaces for algorithmic trading, RFQ pricing and execution. This is a hands-on opportunity to shape greenfield applications, influence architecture and work with advanced technologies. Bring real-time market data, AI-powered insights and large-scale analytics together in intelligent trading widgets that support live trading decisions. We’re looking for strong TypeScript and React expertise, curiosity and a passion for solving challenging engineering problems. Build technology traders use every day, with direct feedback and visible impact across our global markets business. 
 Job responsibilities 

- Partner directly with traders to understand workflows, identify opportunities and translate business needs into effective trading applications. 

- Design, build and optimise high-performance, low-latency UIs for algo trading, RFQ pricing, execution monitoring and risk management. 

- Contribute to greenfield development, shaping application architecture, reusable components and real-time data integration. 

- Develop intelligent trading widgets and visualisations that combine streaming data, AI-driven insights and large-scale analytics. 

- Optimise rendering, data processing and responsiveness to keep applications reliable under high-frequency market updates. 

- Own features throughout the development lifecycle, from design and prototyping to implementation, testing and production support. 

- Collaborate across global engineering teams, contribute to design and code reviews, and mentor colleagues. 

- Uphold standards for security, resilience, accessibility and automated testing, while improving development and delivery practices. 
 
 Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills 
 
- Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS, with deep expertise in React or a comparable modern UI framework. 

- Demonstrated experience delivering complex, production-grade applications and taking ownership of technical decisions and delivery. 

- Experience building real-time, data-intensive interfaces, including streaming updates, high-performance grids and interactive visualisations. 

- Strong understanding of browser performance, asynchronous programming, client-side state management and event-driven architectures. 

- Experience profiling and optimising UI rendering and responsiveness under demanding data volumes. 

- Sound computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, networking and concurrency. 

- Experience with automated testing, modern build tooling, CI/CD and the software development lifecycle. 

- Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to discuss technical trade-offs and collaborate directly with business users. 

- A pragmatic, results-oriented approach and the ability to work effectively across geographically distributed teams. 

- A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 
 Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills 
 
- Electronic trading, algorithmic execution, RFQ pricing or market-making workflows. 

- Integrating AI/ML capabilities into applications, such as decision support, anomaly detection or natural-language interaction. 

- Large-scale analytics, time-series data and technologies such as kdb+. 

- WebSockets, messaging middleware, distributed caches and trading protocols such as FIX. 

- Python, backend API design, cloud platforms or taking greenfield applications from concept to production.

jobs.jd:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

 If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

 Senior Full-Stack Engineer - AI Agent Platform 

 London Office - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home 

 About the Role 

 We're building an AI-powered financial crime investigation platform that's transforming how Ebury's compliance teams work. Our AI agents will process thousands of screening cases, reducing analyst workload while maintaining regulatory standards.

 We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to help us scale our platform and raise the engineering bar. You'll architect and deliver complex features across the entire stack - from React frontends to Python backends to LLM integrations - while mentoring teammates and shaping our technical direction.

 This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of AI/ML, fintech, and compliance - building production AI systems that handle real financial crime investigations at scale.

 What You'll Do 

- Architect and build end-to-end features across our React frontend and FastAPI backend, making sound technical decisions that balance speed with maintainability

- Design AI agent workflows using LangGraph for screening automation, RAG pipelines, and multi-agent orchestration

- Lead technical initiatives - own complex features from design to production, breaking down ambiguous problems into actionable work

- Integrate complex data sources (internal APIs, third-party services like LexisNexis, data warehouse) with robust error handling and observability

- Improve platform reliability - implement monitoring, alerting, and performance optimizations for production AI systems

- Mentor and uplift junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance

- Shape engineering practices - contribute to architecture decisions, coding standards, and team processes

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Design, Compliance, and other engineering teams to deliver impactful solutions

 Tech Stack: 

 Frontend: 

- React, TypeScript, Material-UI

- Module Federation (Micro-frontend architecture)

- Vite, Vitest

 Backend: 

- Python 3.13, FastAPI

- LangGraph (AI agent orchestration)

- LlamaIndex (RAG/vector search)

- AWS Bedrock

- DynamoDB, OpenSearch Serverless

 Infrastructure: 

- AWS (ECS Fargate, Lambda, API Gateway, S3)

- Terraform, GitHub Actions

- Docker, Kubernetes

- Sentry, Langfuse (LLM observability)

 What We're Looking For 

 Must Have

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

- Strong React + TypeScript skills - you can architect complex frontend applications with good state management, performance, and testing

- Strong Python backend experience - FastAPI, Django, or Flask with async programming, clean architecture, and production-grade code

- System design skills - you can design scalable, maintainable systems and articulate trade-offs clearly

- API design expertise - REST, WebSockets/SSE, and understanding of distributed systems patterns

- Database proficiency - SQL and NoSQL (DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch), including query optimization and data modeling

- Testing mindset - you write comprehensive tests and advocate for quality across the team

- Ownership mentality - you take features from idea to production, proactively identifying and solving problems

- Strong communication - you can explain complex technical concepts to engineers and non-engineers alike, and write clear documentation

- Mentorship ability - you enjoy helping others grow and have experience guiding less experienced engineers

 Nice to Have 

- LLM/AI experience - LangChain, LangGraph, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, or fine-tuning

- Production AI systems - experience with LLM observability (Langfuse), token management, streaming, and reliability patterns

- AWS expertise - Lambda, ECS, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Bedrock, or similar cloud services

- Streaming architectures - SSE, WebSockets, event-driven systems

- Fintech/compliance background - AML, sanctions screening, KYC, or regulated industry experience

- Micro-frontend experience - Module Federation, independent deployability

- Infrastructure as Code - Terraform, CDK, or similar

 What Sets Senior Apart 

 We're looking for engineers who demonstrate:

- Technical leadership - You don't just complete tasks; you identify the right problems to solve and influence technical direction

- Systems thinking - You consider the broader context: scalability, security, observability, and maintainability

- Proactive communication - You surface risks early, propose solutions, and keep stakeholders informed

- Quality advocacy - You raise the bar for testing, code review, and documentation across the team

- Pragmatic decision-making - You balance ideal solutions with delivery timelines, making conscious trade-offs

- Continuous learning - You stay current with industry trends and bring new ideas to the team

 Why Join Us? 

 🚀 Greenfield AI Product

 You'll help shape a product from early stages, not maintain legacy code. Your architectural decisions will have lasting impact.

 📈 Technical Leadership

 Drive technical direction for a growing team. Mentor engineers and establish patterns that scale.

As a Lead Engineer in Making Payments, part of Xero’s Payments Platform, you will own the technical lifecycle of bill payments: the way small businesses pay their bills and their people through Xero. You’ll get deep exposure to payments at scale and room to shape architecture, delivery and team capability.

Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it.

You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver.

- Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified.

- Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers.

- Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices.

You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place.

You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written.

On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur.

You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back.

jobs.jd:
Do you want to work deep inside a database that processes billions of transactions every day across Amazon's consumer and digital businesses? Our team builds the data platforms at the core of Amazon, storing customer orders, catalog and product information, shopping carts, device data, and hundreds of other business-critical datasets. The performance and availability of our platform is critical to the reliability of the Amazon brand, and we run some of the largest fleets and highest-throughput services at the company.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who understands distributed systems at scale and wants to shape the shared storage layer of our next-generation online transaction processing (OLTP) database. You will design how committed transactions are materialized to cloud object storage, how space is reclaimed as data is superseded, and how data nodes read back through a storage-format-agnostic contract. You will partner with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to leverage cloud-native technologies and contribute innovations back to the broader market. If you thrive on solving ambiguous, high-impact problems from design to delivery, we would love to hear from you. 

Key job responsibilities
* Design, develop, and operate the distributed shared storage layer that holds the durable copy of every committed write for Amazon's mission-critical OLTP database platform.
* Collaborate with Senior Engineers and peers to define technical solutions for complex problems such as storage engine design, durability and consistency protocols, read-path caching, and backpressure under load.
* Own end-to-end delivery of features, from writing design documents and implementing production-quality code to driving operational readiness and deployment.
* Mentor engineers through design and code reviews, pairing on hard problems, and helping them take on larger pieces of the system while raising the team's quality bar.
* Build monitoring, alarming, and automation that keep our high-throughput services reliable, and participate in on-call rotations to troubleshoot issues and drive root-cause resolution.

A day in the life
You will split your time between deep individual work like writing code, reviewing designs, and prototyping storage-layer changes, and collaborative sessions with your team and partner teams. Expect regular design reviews where you debate trade-offs around durability, latency, and cost, along with weekly operational reviews that keep the platform healthy. Some weeks you will be heads-down implementing a new compaction strategy; other weeks you will pair with a teammate to debug a subtle consistency issue in production. 

About the team
Our team sits within the Transact organization and is responsible for the storage engine layer that underpins Amazon's OLTP platform that powers all Amazon Stores. We are a group of engineers who care deeply about correctness, performance, and operational rigor. We partner closely with AWS service teams, sharing innovations in both directions. Our focus over the coming years is scaling the next-generation storage layer to meet Amazon's growing transaction volume while improving efficiency and reducing costs, and we are looking for engineers who want to help shape that future.

Basic qualifications:
- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Frontify is the brand platform behind some of the world's leading organizations, including Microsoft, Telefónica, Bosch, Mercedes-Benz, and Kia. We're driven by collaboration, curiosity, and the belief that great work can happen anywhere. What began in St. Gallen has grown to London, New York, and beyond. Wherever you join us, you'll take ownership from day one, shape work that reaches global brands, and help redefine how brands work in the age of AI.



What you'll shape

You'll ensure that Frontify's system infrastructure is cared for, maintained, and improved – it's a fast-changing infrastructure, so there's always something going on. Working closely with the R&D team, you'll investigate and identify the root cause of infrastructure issues, enabling the team to resolve them, as well as document relevant processes. Beyond managing the daily infrastructure needs, you'll be the first point of contact for our Europe- and US-based teams on anything related to the technical aspects of our platform.



What you'll do

 - Help develop and maintain a robust monitoring and observability framework to ensure system performance, reliability, and early issue detection.

 - Leverage your experience in DevOps to design, maintain, and improve cloud infrastructure.

 - Own and evolve incident management processes, including on-call, postmortems, SLOs, and error budgets.

 - Manage and optimize web servers, relational databases, and Linux-based systems.

 - Utilize expertise in Docker for containerization and manage orchestration tools such as Kubernetes or AWS ECS to ensure smooth deployment and scalability.

 - Work with AWS services to build and maintain scalable and secure cloud-based solutions.

 - Work remotely from anywhere in Switzerland or join us on-site in our St. Gallen office, with the flexibility to choose your best work environment.

 

What you bring

 - You’re an IT generalist who’s comfortable shaping and defining the role with us.

 - You have a strong understanding of monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Datadog or Grafana).

 - You have experience applying SRE principles such as SLOs, and error budgets.

 - You have worked with incident management processes, including conducting postmortems and driving improvements.

 - You have a solid understanding of security practices in cloud and DevOps environments, including identity and access management (IAM), data protection, secrets management, and compliance considerations (e.g., ISO, GDPR).

 - You’re comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed team environment.

 - You speak English fluently.

 

What we offer

 - A minimum of 25 days annual leave per year

 - Parental, family care, and bereavement leave

 - Daily sickness benefits and accident insurance

 - Paid educational and wellbeing days off

 - Wellbeing, learning and development, and commuter allowance

 - Home office setup budget

 - Pension fund: contributions paid 60% by us and 40% by you

 - Workation: Work from inspiring locations around the world for up to 45 days per year!

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Data Center Builder Tools
jobs.jd:
The Data Center Builder Tools team is looking for a seasoned, self-directed Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE III) to lead the design and evolution of the real-time middleware and controls platform that powers industrial control systems across AWS Data Centers worldwide. Contribute to Amazon's vision of developing the safest, most secure, reliable, and efficient data centers on Earth.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on this team, you will set the technical direction for the software that sits between industrial hardware and the cloud, a unified, real-time data plane that lets control applications, device drivers, and cloud services exchange data reliably on industrial computing hardware. This is deep systems work at the boundary of software and hardware: you will own the architecture of the controls, the communication layer, and the protocol and cloud integrations that the entire platform is built on, and you will be the engineer others turn to for the hardest problems in real-time, distributed, and embedded systems.

In this role you will

Own the architecture: of the real-time middleware and controls, the data-exchange layer, canonical type system, and communication patterns (publish/subscribe and request/reply) that connect distributed control applications across languages and hardware and drive it through multiple iterations as requirements scale.

Set technical strategy: for how the platform integrates with industrial automation platforms and hardware protocols (e.g. IEC 61131-3, EtherCAT, PROFINET, Modbus, OPC-UA, IO-Link) and how new device drivers are built, so the platform scales to many protocols without bespoke effort.

Define the edge-to-cloud contract: how telemetry, metrics, and commands flow between devices and AWS services, with the right delivery guarantees, quality-of-service, and failure semantics for each class of data.

Solve the defining hard problems: of a system where correctness means both the right result and the right timing, bounded latency, determinism, resource constraints on embedded hardware, and graceful degradation when connectivity is lost.

Multiply the team: establish engineering standards, mentor SDE I/IIs and raise the bar in hiring, reviews, and design, and align hardware, controls, security, and operations partners around a shared technical vision.

If you're excited by low-level systems, real-time data and connecting physical equipment to the cloud at scale and by being the technical leader who makes it happen this is the role for you.

Key job responsibilities
As an SDE III on this team, you are a technical leader accountable for the architecture and long-term health of the controls and middleware platform, not just individual components. You will operate across multiple workstreams and teams, make the consequential design decisions, and remain deeply hands-on where it matters most.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

* Architecting the platform, not just components: owning the end-to-end design of the controls and real-time middleware across embedded/edge controllers and the cloud, making the durable decisions on type systems, serialization, memory layout, schema evolution, and communication patterns that everything else depends on.

* Driving multi-year technical strategy: defining the roadmap for the next iteration of "What comes next", industrial protocol support, and cloud integration, sequencing the work, and making explicit build-vs-buy and short-term-vs-durable tradeoffs with the data to back them.

* Owning real-time correctness at system scale: reasoning about latency budgets, throughput, determinism, and failure modes across a distributed system adjacent to physical control loops, and setting the standards that keep those guarantees intact as the system grows.

* Leading cross-team and cross-discipline efforts: turning ambiguous, org-level requirements into clear technical direction, and aligning hardware, controls, security, and operations partners (and other software teams) around shared interfaces and contracts.

* Raising the engineering bar broadly: establishing standards for testing (unit, integration, and on-hardware validation), performance benchmarking, operational excellence, and code quality, and holding the team to them through design and code review.

* Growing engineers: mentoring Junior and Mid level SDE, developing their technical judgment, and contributing as a strong interviewer and bar raiser in hiring.

* De-risking the hardest problems: personally diving into the highest-ambiguity, highest-impact technical challenges (new protocol integrations, performance-critical paths, cross-language data exchange) and bringing them to a proven, maintainable end state.

The ideal candidate is a senior software engineer with a track record of owning the architecture of complex software systems and delivering them to production. You have depth across several of: real-time or embedded systems, industrial automation platforms and hardware protocols, distributed systems, middleware/messaging (pub/sub, RPC), and cloud communication and the breadth to reason about how all of these fit together into a coherent platform. You are comfortable working close to the metal (memory, concurrency, serialization, timing) and setting direction at the system and organizational level. You influence beyond your own team, make sound decisions under ambiguity and hardware/timing constraints, and lift the engineers around you. Experience with Rust, C/C++, or Python, and with technologies such as industrial automation platforms, OPC-UA, DDS/Zenoh or similar real-time middleware, is a strong advantage.

A day in the life
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers

Senior Data System Software engineer: Oracle Database 26ai and client drivers System Test Engineering 

 Database Product Development | Senior Lead or Principal Level 

 Role summary This role combines hands-on Oracle database development with component, integration, system, stress, and performance testing. The engineer will build automated test solutions for Oracle Database 26ai, Oracle client drivers, converged database features, and the major Oracle client drivers on Windows and Linux. 
 Team and mission 
 The SHARP VLDB organisation improves the scalability, high availability, reliability, and performance of Oracle Database and cloud services. The team designs realistic, high-volume and highly concurrent workloads that expose product defects and architectural limitations before release. Engineers work closely with database kernel, feature, client drivers, cloud, and support teams to reproduce issues, verify fixes, and strengthen product quality across on-premises and cloud deployments. 
 Role at a glance 

 Primary focus 

 Database feature development and cross-platform system test engineering 

 Target database 

 Oracle Database 26ai with vector and AI capabilities 

 Platforms 

 Windows Server and Linux, including cross-platform compatibility and interoperability 

 Database areas 

 XDB, JSON, Oracle Text, SQL and PL/SQL, multitenant and high availability 

 ODAC scope 

 ODP.NET Core, Managed and Unmanaged providers and related ODAC components 

 Client drivers 

 python-oracledb, node-oracledb, OCI-C driver and JDBC 

 Test coverage 

 Functional, integration, compatibility, upgrade, patch, system, stress, performance and resiliency

Design and develop production-scale database schemas, data generators, workload drivers, and application logic using SQL, PL/SQL, Python, Java, JavaScript or Node.js, C/C++, and C# as appropriate. 
 • Create highly automated end-to-end test suites that simulate large enterprise applications, high concurrency, long-duration operation, mixed workloads, and very large databases. 
 • Review Oracle Database 26ai feature designs and translate functional and architectural requirements into test strategies, coverage matrices, test specifications, and reusable automation. 
 • Validate Oracle Database 26ai vector and AI capabilities, including vector data types, vector indexes, similarity search, hybrid vector and text scenarios, embedding workflows, concurrency, correctness, performance, and upgrade compatibility. 
 • Develop comprehensive coverage for XDB and XML processing, JSON data management and APIs, and Oracle Text indexing, search, synchronization, security, and mixed-workload interoperability.

jobs.title: Sr Software Development Engineer , AWS IoT Fleet Management
jobs.jd:
AWS IoT is building the infrastructure to deliver AI from the cloud to the physical world. Our Physical AI team is developing services that provision, deploy, monitor, and secure AI software across every processor inside autonomous machines — including robots, vehicles, drones, agricultural equipment, and industrial workcells — operating in environments with limited or no cloud connectivity.
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to define and drive the architecture of our edge-first fleet management platform for Physical AI. You will own the end-to-end system design spanning cloud control planes, edge gateways, and device-tier processors — reasoning deeply about state, consistency, partition tolerance, failure domains, recovery, and reconciliation across tiers that are routinely disconnected from each other. You will design APIs, platform abstractions, and SDKs that enable customers to manage heterogeneous machine fleets as coherent units, and architect secure software and model distribution pipelines with hardware attestation, cryptographic signing, and device-bound authorization.
This role demands the ability to start from ambiguity and deliver production architecture. You will take large, loosely defined initiatives and decompose them into parallel workstreams that L4 and L5 engineers can execute against. You will write high-quality architecture and design documents that set the technical bar for the team, lead cross-team technical discussions, and drive alignment on decisions that affect adjacent services and organizations. You will own operational excellence for device fleets at scale — not just service availability, but the health, versioning, and security posture of tens of thousands of physical processors in the field.
This is an opportunity to be a technical leader on a foundational new AWS platform — shaping how intelligence is delivered, protected, and maintained across the physical world at scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end architecture of an edge-first fleet management platform for Physical AI, spanning cloud control planes, edge gateways, and device-tier processors.
- Design for intermittent connectivity: reason about state, consistency, partition tolerance, failure domains, recovery, and reconciliation across tiers that are routinely disconnected from each other.
- Define APIs, platform abstractions, and SDKs that let customers manage heterogeneous machine fleets — robots, vehicles, drones, agricultural equipment, industrial workcells — as coherent units.
- Architect secure software and model distribution pipelines, including hardware attestation, cryptographic signing, and device-bound authorization.
- Take large, loosely defined initiatives and decompose them into parallel workstreams that L4 and L5 engineers can execute independently.
- Write high-quality architecture and design documents that set the technical bar and lead cross-team technical discussions to drive alignment on decisions affecting adjacent services and organizations.
- Model device topologies across gateways, subordinate processors, sensors, and controllers, and design edge AI/ML model deployment with compatibility and versioning at scale.
- Own operational excellence for device fleets at scale — the health, versioning, and security posture of tens of thousands of physical processors in the field, not just service availability.
- Establish hardware root-of-trust and secure OTA practices (TUF/Uptane, TPM/HSM, secure boot, attestation) in partnership with security, hardware, and adjacent platform teams.
- Mentor and raise the technical bar for L4 and L5 engineers through design review, code review, and direct technical guidance.

A day in the life
ou might start your morning pairing with a senior engineer to trace a failed OTA update on an embedded processor then switch to writing and testing a new peer-discovery module for link-local networks. After standup you could review a teammate's Rust pull request join a design discussion on artifact-caching strategies for offline topologies or try a new concurrency pattern that could improve deployment coordination. You will pick up embedded and robotics concepts quickly as you work hands-on with real autonomous hardware.

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Platform - Moveworks
jobs.jd:
The Role 
 We're building the runtime infrastructure that powers Moveworks' AI agents — the systems that orchestrate, execute, and deliver agent responses to millions of enterprise users in real time. This role sits where large language models meet distributed systems. You'll apply machine learning, LLM, and distributed systems expertise to make agents plan, reason, and use tools reliably, and you'll build the production systems that run those agents at enterprise scale.

Our AI agents can plan, execute multi-step workflows, call tools, wait on human input, and resume — all while maintaining correctness, observability, and low latency. The systems that make this possible are what you'll build and own.

 What you get to do in this role: 
 
- Agent orchestration engine — A state machine that manages long-running agent sessions, coordinating planning, execution, and user interaction across multiple LLM calls and tool invocations

- Model routing and adaptation — Choose, route between, and fine-tune or distill LLMs for specific agent tasks. Meet enterprise requirements such as granular permissions, data freshness, explainability, and preserving general knowledge.

- Distributed session management — Lease-based ownership using conditional writes, heartbeat protocols, and crash recovery via checkpointing

- Event-driven message pipeline — FIFO queues for ordered delivery, consumers for event processing, and real-time streaming via gRPC and Socket.IO 

- Structured concurrency — Running multiple concurrent tasks per session with fail-fast semantics and graceful cancellation

- Observability infrastructure — OpenTelemetry instrumentation, distributed trace context propagation across async boundaries, custom span lifecycle management for sessions that span minutes

- Caching and state layers — Redis, DynamoDB KV stores with per-org/per-bot scoping, batch read optimization, and hot-reload configuration

- Tool and agent connectivity for LLMs: Build MCP and agent-to-agent (A2A) capabilities, including tool discovery, namespacing, and tool selection over large tool catalogs, so the LLM picks and calls the right tool from thousands of candidates.

- Token efficiency and context engineering — Lower the agent's cost and latency through prompt and context discipline, caching, speculative and parallel model-call scheduling, and reducing tokens spent across multi-step LLM reasoning chains.

- Open-weights model adoption and evaluation — Quickly stand up newly released open-weights LLMs at different quantization levels, run them in a test environment, and benchmark their accuracy, latency and cost on agent tasks. Use the results to decide which models reach production.

To be successful in this role you have: 
 You should have deep experience in at least 3 of these areas: 
 
- Distributed systems: consistency models, idempotency, exactly-once delivery, distributed locking/leasing

- Concurrent/async programming: Python asyncio, Go goroutines, structured concurrency, cancellation handling

- Event-driven architectures: message queues (SQS, Kafka), pub/sub, backpressure, delivery guarantees

- Database systems for infrastructure: DynamoDB (conditional writes, transactions), Redis (connection pooling, pub/sub)

- Observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, span context propagation, Prometheus metrics

- gRPC/protobuf: streaming RPCs, service interface design, error handling patterns

- Machine learning: Large language models, natural language processing, LLM evaluation

 Required: 
 
- 5+ years building production backend/infrastructure systems

- Strong in Python or Go (ideally both)

- Experience designing and operating systems that handle real traffic at scale

- Hands-on experience building production systems that use LLMs or other ML models

- Comfort with ambiguity — these are novel problems without textbook solutions

 Relevant past experience: 
 
- Building and shipping products on large language models with techniques such as RAG, chain-of-thought, self-reflection, tool and function calling, and agentic reasoning.

- Training, fine-tuning, or evaluating machine learning models on large datasets in production, especially for NLP, retrieval, or ranking.

- Improving relevance or quality through careful experimentation: designing metrics, building evaluation datasets, and developing new features and signals for ranking or model selection.

- Research or applied work in machine learning, LLMs, agentic systems, information retrieval, or ranking and relevance.

 The Okta Secures AI Team 

 The Okta Secures AI Team is building the future of digital identity management. The way companies are using agents and allowing them access is undergoing a fundamental shift, enabling teams to move fast while staying secure. 

 Our North Star is clear: To get AI right, you have to get identity right. We are not just managing identities; we are building the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. As organizations rapidly deploy AI, these non-human entities are acting with access to critical tools, often bypassing traditional perimeters and creating a 'Shadow AI' crisis. Our mission is to move identity from a reactive gatekeeper to a unified control plane, transforming AI risk into business ROI.

 We are tackling this by implementing a comprehensive four-pillar maturity model: Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern. We are driving innovation by defining the standards for Agent Identity—including pioneer work with the AI Agent Tool Registry and support for protocols like MCP and IPSIE. You will be helping us build the infrastructure that allows enterprises to scale AI safely, ensuring every access decision—whether made by a human or an automated agent—is authenticated, authorized, and audited at scale.

 We are a diverse team of engineers, product managers, and designers who are bringing Okta’s expertise in identity to define the future of Agent Identity management, focusing on enablement while staying secure.

 The Staff FullStack Engineer Opportunity 

 As a Staff Fullstack Engineer on the Okta Secures AI team, your mission is to build the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. jobs.jd:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 This role supports Okta's U.S. federal environments and requires U.S. federal eligibility, including U.S. citizenship. 

 The Team 

 Okta Workflows is a no-code automation platform that lets IT and security teams automate identity processes at scale: onboarding and offboarding, access requests, event-driven responses to security signals, and integrations across hundreds of SaaS applications. Every one of those automations ultimately runs on a single execution engine, and that is where this team lives. 

 The Opportunity 

 The Engine Kernel team owns the runtime that executes every Okta Workflow. Our engine treats a workflow the way an operating system treats a process: it schedules, pauses, resumes, and coordinates executions across a high-throughput, multi-region distributed system. The engine is written in Rust and runs on Kubernetes. 

 We are accountable for the reliability, scale, performance, and cost of the core workflow lifecycle, and we hold a very high bar for availability because our customers' identity automation depends on it. 

 Some of the problems you would work on: 

- Durable execution: evolving how the engine persists and recovers workflow state so long-running automations are resilient by design. 

- Smarter scheduling: reducing the cost of durability so the engine can checkpoint work cheaply and keep latency low and predictable. 

- Resilience under load: building adaptive throttling and backpressure directly into the runtime. 

- Efficiency at scale: cutting I/O, compute, and infrastructure cost as workflow volume grows, without giving up performance. 

- Operational excellence: improving observability, tooling, and automation so we find and fix issues before customers notice. 

 AI Assisted Engineering 

 We actively use AI coding assistants (such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, and Gemini) to move faster across the development lifecycle: prototyping, refactoring, generating tests, and documenting complex systems. We are looking for an engineer who uses these tools well and has the judgment to review, debug, and harden AI-generated code before it reaches a system that runs our customers' identity automation. 

 What you’ll be doing 

 As a Staff Software Engineer on the Engine Kernel team, you will: 

- Own large engine projects end to end, from design and spikes through implementation, rollout, monitoring, and alerting, and deliver them on time with a high bar for quality. 

- Design components of a high-throughput distributed runtime independently, bring them through design review, and make sound trade-offs between latency, durability, cost, and complexity. 

- Use proofs of concept, benchmarks, and production observability tools to make data-driven decisions about engine behavior and performance. 

- Participate in the team's Guardian and vulnerability triage rotations: independently troubleshoot production incidents, identify root causes, and drive remediation. 

- Drive operational improvement projects, such as reducing alert noise, closing monitoring gaps, and hardening the infrastructure the engine runs on. 

- Identify tech debt in a mature, evolving codebase, explain its impact on team velocity, and lead the work to pay it down. 

- Partner with adjacent Workflows teams (API, routing, data layer, connectors, infrastructure, SRE) and with Product to shape requirements for reliability, performance, and resilience. 

- Help customers have a great experience by working with Support, Customer Success, and the field on escalations that reach the engine. 

- Raise the bar for the team through thoughtful code reviews, mentoring, and sharing knowledge widely. 

 What you’ll bring to the role 

- U.S. citizenship and the ability to meet U.S. federal eligibility requirements for this role. 

- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating backend or distributed systems in production. 

- Strong proficiency in Rust , or deep experience in another systems language (C++) and a clear interest in becoming productive in Rust quickly. 

- Solid understanding of asynchronous and concurrent programming: event loops, async runtimes (for example, Tokio), thread pools, and the performance trade-offs between I/O-bound and CPU-bound work.

jobs.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.jd:
Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met.

Key Responsibilities
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
–Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools.
–Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems.
–Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members.
–Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
–Implements performance and load testing.
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
–Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
–Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions.
–Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability.
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
–Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures.
–Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures.
–Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health.
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
–Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system.
–Implements tests scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
–Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
–Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation.
–Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
–Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues.
–Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations.
Compliance & Security:
–Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls.
–Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security.
–Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date
Automation & Change Management:
–Maintains automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure.
–Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications.
 
Core Responsibilities
Planning & Execution:
–Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. 
–Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance
Collaboration & Partnership:
–Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.
Problem Solving:
–Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices
Continuous Learning:
–Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members..
Continuous Improvement:
–Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

Our team is building an advanced conversational platform that helps customers discover, compare, and choose products effortlessly through natural, AI-driven interactions. We’re looking for engineers who are passionate about crafting scalable systems, leveraging AI technologies, and delivering seamless, personalized experiences to millions of users.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, collaborating across disciplines, and working on products that redefine how people shop online, this role offers a unique opportunity to make an impact at scale.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer II, you will:

- Design, implement, and deliver scalable software components that power next-generation conversational shopping experiences.
- Take full ownership of the software development lifecycle - from technical design and coding through to deployment 
- Write clean, reliable, and efficient code that meets high standards for quality, performance, and maintainability.
- Partner closely with product managers, designers, applied scientists, and other engineers to translate product ideas into technical deliverables.
- Contribute to the long-term technical vision and architecture for conversational and AI-powered experiences.
- Stay current with emerging technologies and integrate them where they add customer or developer value.
- Mentor other engineers through code reviews, design sessions, and hands-on collaboration.
- Participate in architecture reviews, design discussions, and sprint planning to continuously improve team effectiveness.
- Identify and drive automation or process improvements that enhance reliability, developer velocity, and overall product quality.
- Support the team’s services through participation in on-call rotations, ensuring system stability and fast resolution of production issues.
- Proactively assess risks and implement safeguards to maintain a secure and resilient infrastructure.

About the team
We're a tight-knit team of engineers building the web experiences that power our conversational shopping platform. We own our systems end-to-end - from design through deployment and beyond.

We operate with a strong ownership mindset. Engineers here don't just write code - they drive decisions, run experiments, and iterate quickly based on real customer data. We ship fast, learn faster, and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions when the data tells us to.

If you value autonomy, love experimenting, and want your work to reach millions of customers, you'll feel right at home with this team.

Basic qualifications:
- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
- Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
