jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Payments
jobs.location: Toronto; Vancouver | New York, NY, United States
jobs.jd:
MongoDB’s mission is to empower innovators to create, transform and disrupt industries by unleashing the power of software and data. Cloud Payments helps make that possible by ensuring that usage of MongoDB Atlas and our growing suite of products becomes accurate, reliable revenue every day. Our systems support the financial foundation of MongoDB’s cloud business, processing large volumes of usage and billing data where correctness, resilience and auditability matter.

About the Cloud Payments team

 Cloud Payments is part of the Cloud Billing organization. As MongoDB’s cloud business grows, billing and payments become increasingly mission-critical. Our team:

- Ingests and aggregates detailed metering and usage data from internal services and major cloud providers, including AWS, Azure and GCP

- Calculates and generates daily customer bills for millions of customers worldwide

- Integrates with payment processors and internal financial systems that support Finance, Sales, Marketing and Accounting

- Improves customer-facing billing and payment experiences, as well as the reliability and scalability of backend systems

 We care deeply about code quality, correctness and observability. We work closely with technical teams and business stakeholders to solve problems that have direct customer and business impact.

The role

 We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to provide technical leadership while designing, building and operating the services that power Cloud Payments. You’ll take on complex, ambiguous problems, shape solutions across service boundaries and help the team make sound engineering decisions for systems that process high-volume, financially significant data.

 You’ll work primarily in the JVM ecosystem, including Java and contribute across the software lifecycle: from clarifying the problem and setting technical direction through implementation, rollout and ongoing operation. You’ll raise the quality and effectiveness of the team through design feedback, mentorship and thoughtful collaboration, without needing formal people-management responsibility.

 This role can be based out of one of our Canadian offices, or remotely within Canada.

What you’ll do

- Lead the technical design and delivery of substantial backend capabilities, from problem definition and requirements through launch, operation and iteration

- Break down ambiguous business and customer needs into pragmatic, well-scoped technical plans; identify risks, dependencies and meaningful tradeoffs early

- Design and evolve reliable, scalable services and data flows that ingest, process, reconcile and report large volumes of usage and billing data

- Set a high bar for correctness, resilience, security, auditability, testability and operability in systems with financial impact

- Guide architecture and implementation across services or teams, building alignment with engineering partners and stakeholders in Product, Finance, Revenue and other organizations

- Make systems easier and safer to operate by improving observability, incident response, automation and operational practices

- Raise engineering quality through design and code reviews, clear technical documentation and constructive feedback

- Mentor and support other engineers, sharing context and helping teammates grow their technical judgment and ownership

- Participate in the on-call rotation and contribute to a sustainable approach to reliability

What we’re looking for

- Significant experience designing, building and operating production backend systems in a compiled OOM language, ideally Java or another JVM language - 6+ years of relevant experience

- Demonstrated ownership of complex projects, including making design decisions, managing delivery risks and following through on launches

- Strong understanding of distributed systems and the practical challenges of availability, consistency, scalability and failure recovery

- Experience designing for data correctness, including patterns such as idempotency, replay safety, reconciliation and auditability

- Ability to reason about service boundaries, APIs, data models and system evolution over time

- Experience with databases, data modeling and access patterns in production

- Strong operational bias: you use observability and production feedback to improve systems and you are willing to not only participate in on-call, but improve operational stance of the team

- Clear communication and a track record of influencing technical decisions across teams and with non-technical stakeholders

- A collaborative approach to technical leadership, including mentoring others and improving the team’s engineering practices

- Self-motivation to solve customer and business problems, not just deliver isolated tickets

Nice to have

- Experience with billing, payments, or other financial systems where correctness, auditability and compliance are important

- Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP or Azure and communication protocols such as gRPC

- Familiarity with data-intensive applications, data pipelines, or data lakes

- Exposure to I/O frameworks such as Reactor

- Experience with containerization and orchestration, such as Docker and Kubernetes

- Prior experience developing with or operating MongoDB

 We don’t expect you to check every box. If you’re excited about the problem space and believe you could make a strong contribution, we’d love to hear from you.

How we’ll support you

 MongoDB is committed to building a supportive, inclusive and growth-oriented environment. Our benefits and working models are designed to support physical, emotional, financial and family well-being and to give people flexibility in how they do their best work.

 You’ll have opportunities to:

- Work on complex, meaningful projects that directly affect MongoDB’s cloud business

- Collaborate with experienced engineers across Cloud Billing and other parts of MongoDB

- Grow through mentorship, feedback and stretch

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Developer Experience - Moveworks
jobs.jd:
The Developer Experience team sits within Moveworks' Platform org , but operates with a vertical mandate: we build products and platforms that serve developers — specifically the developers at Moveworks customer environments who are building on top of the Moveworks Agentic AI platform.
 Our north star is supply. Every developer we enable, every integration they ship faster, every higher-quality skill or workflow they publish — that compounds into more value for the employees who rely on the assistant every day. More builders → more things built → better assistant → more demand. We own that flywheel.
 To do this well, we build platforms first. Scalable, general-purpose developer infrastructure that products can be built on top of — and then we build those products too. The team lives at the intersection of platform engineering discipline and developer-facing product thinking.
 As a Senior Engineer on the Developer Experience team, you are the technical foundation the team builds on. You own the hardest platform problems — generality, scalability, extensibility — while keeping the developer experience as the measure of success. You think in systems: what's the right abstraction, what does this need to support in two years, how do you build something that a developer in a customer environment can actually depend on?
 You're not just an architect. You ship. And you bring others along with you.
 
- Design and build the core developer platforms that power the MW developer ecosystem — SDKs, APIs, runtime abstractions, tooling infrastructure, and developer-facing services

- Own end-to-end delivery of agentic developer products that increase developer productivity: faster time-to-market, higher-quality artifacts, lower integration friction

- Define the platform primitives that other products and teams build on — with a strong bias toward generality, reliability, and clean abstractions

- Drive measurable improvements in developer supply metrics: developer activation, integration velocity, quality of published artifacts, and ecosystem breadth

- Lead technical strategy for your platform areas — roadmap input, API design, and cross-team technical alignment

- Set the engineering bar: architecture reviews, design standards, observability, and operational excellence

- Mentor senior engineers and raise the team's overall technical depth
 The best Senior Engineers on this team are multipliers — not just of code, but of developer capability. You should be able to look at a developer pain point, trace it to a platform gap, design the right general solution, and ship it in a way that unlocks a category of use cases rather than solving one at a time. You raise the abstraction level of everything you touch.

- 5+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production systems; significant experience on platform or infrastructure teams

- Proven ability to build general-purpose, developer-facing platforms — SDKs, APIs, developer tooling, or integration frameworks — at scale

- Strong distributed systems fundamentals: service reliability, API design, performance, fault tolerance, and operational observability

- Backend engineering depth in Python and/or Go (or equivalent); fluent in microservices and cloud-native patterns

- Experience building platforms that other engineers build on top of — you understand what makes an abstraction good vs. leaky

- Product sensibility for developer experience: you can feel the difference between a platform that delights and one that frustrates, and you close that gap
 Nice to Have 
 
- Experience building agentic systems, LLM-powered developer tooling, or AI-assisted development products

- Familiarity with developer ecosystem growth — activation funnels, SDK adoption, developer community feedback loops

- Exposure to enterprise developer environments and the constraints they impose (auth, sandboxing, compliance, multi-tenancy)

jobs.jd:
Senior FX Cross Border Payments and AI Engineer 
 
 Overview 
 As the world’s most global bank, Citi gives you the tools to be a trailblazer. We’re not just building technology; we’re building the future of banking. With thousands of employees located around the globe, we are an international team encompassing a broad range of teams, roles, and cultures, and we invite you to come and join us!
 
 Citi’s technology team supports business operations in 100+ countries, across multiple lines of business spanning both Institutional and retail businesses.
 The group works to optimize the IT environment by standardizing production platforms, reducing complexity, and introducing innovative solutions that provide new business capabilities, reduce total cost of ownership, and create a competitive advantage for Citi.
 
 We want to regularly engage with talented individuals who are passionate about producing clean, testable code as part of a high performing team. We have found this to be way more important than experience in the financial sector.
 We welcome applications from any industry and should you wish to apply your application will be reviewed for a multitude of Developer positions at varying levels.
 
 What We do / The Team 

- Citi FX has a physical presence in 83 countries with 1,400 dedicated staff giving us the largest FX presence of any bank globally. Foreign Exchange has been one of the defining businesses of Citi for much of its 200 year existence. 

- Citi has the largest FX presence of any bank globally and we proudly put this down to delivering unrivalled service and insight to our clients. Increasing investment in technology has seen us roll out award winning applications. Technology is a central pillar for our plans to sustain and grow our FX business. 

- Above all, we seek individuals who seek exceptional attitude and aptitude in the people they work with and have a demonstrated passion for delivering FX technology in support of our #1 FX business. 

 Role Overview/What will you do: 

- As a Senior Java Engineer, your mission is to help shape our team of innovators and technologists toward creating next-level solutions that improve the way our business is run.

- Hands on technical implementation of Cross border FX payments and custody solutions using modern, cloud-native technologies and CI/CD workflows, focusing on consolidation, automation, and scalability.

- Drive the design and development of system architecture, work with end-users of the systems, and enhance the quality of deliverables Ensure staff follows Citi documented policy and procedures as well as maintain desktop procedures and supporting documentation for filings on a current basis and in comprehensive manner

- The successful candidate will work with teams across FX Technology implement solutions that benefit the business

- Collaborate with stakeholders across sales , trading , Quants and Product team to understand Payments needs, translate them into impactful data-driven solutions, and deliver these in partnership with technology.

- Design, Development, Testing of new features in the applications.

- Continual improvement of the software development lifecycle and quality of the product.

- 3rd line support of the production system (dedicated 24h support teams handle 1st / 2nd line).

- Mentoring junior members of the team.

- Contribute to defining and implementing best practices and processes for the department and ensure transparency and consistency across teams
 
 Key Skills and Experience required – 

- Master’s degree or above (or equivalent education) in a STEM discipline.

- Proven experience in software engineering and development, and a strong understanding of computer systems and how they operate.

- Hands on Experience in Java , Spring, Understanding of ultra-low-latency development practices.

- Proven understanding of FX highly preferred

- Well versed with AI coding tools like Devin , Claude code and Codex and delivered production grade applications.

- Proven track record of building new systems, replacing legacy systems and renovating existing systems

- Strong skill set in SQL / Databases

- Strong understanding of Messaging tech like Kafka, Solace , MQ etc.

- Writing production scale applications to use the Caching technologies.

- The candidate will have systems (software, hardware, networks) knowledge required to define solutions and trouble shoot issues

- Exceptional communicator who loves working with people, confident communicating at all levels from an individual team to the entire enterprise

- Highly credible hands on engineer, confident to deep dive into a product and codebase and offer detailed, constructive analysis and feedback

- Awareness of industry trends and leveraging new technologies as appropriate
 
 Any Beneficial / Nice to have skills and experience: 
 
- Understanding of Openshift , Kubernetes

- KDB knowledge

 What we’ll provide you 
 By joining Citi London, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive base salary (which is annually reviewed), and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits such as:
 
- 27 days annual leave (plus bank holidays)

- A discretional annual performance related bonus

- Private Medical Care & Life Insurance

- Employee Assistance Program

- Pension Plan

- Paid Parental Leave

- Special discounts for employees, family, and friends

- Access to an array of learning and development resources
 
 Visit our Global Benefits page to learn more. 
 
 Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self, every day. We want the best talent around the world to be energized to join us, motivated to stay and empowered to thrive.

jobs.title: Senior Developer, Billing Platform
jobs.jd:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



The Billing & Payments Engineering team builds and owns the mission-critical systems that power 1Password’s revenue engine end-to-end. We are responsible for the highly available architecture that enables seamless subscription management, complex payment processing, and global financial compliance. From managing the intricate logic of the subscription lifecycle—creations, renewals, upgrades, and cancellations—to integrating with diverse payment gateways and app-store ecosystems, our work ensures a frictionless experience for our customers. As a team, we are actively architecting the next generation of our billing infrastructure, modernizing and consolidating our systems to support rapidly scaling product lines, guarantee absolute data integrity, and ensure robust integrations with downstream financial workflows.



In this role, you’ll design, build, and operate reliable backend services while owning complex initiatives from initial design through production. Your work will help create a safer, simpler digital future by making it easier for customers to access and rely on 1Password.

Lead AI Engineer

Mastercard is seeking a Lead AI Engineer to join a small, focused AI technology team led by one of Mastercard's Distinguished Engineers. · Partner with central security, privacy, legal and AI governance teams, and with the MCP SIG and OW working group, implementing their requirements correctly for the platform's architecture. 

· Keep current with a rapidly evolving landscape, such as new MCP developments, frontier open weight releases, and related agentic protocols, and help the team decide what to adopt, prototype, or wait on.

· Intense curiosity about technology in general, and AI in particular, and who can demonstrate their learning agility outside the bounds of a specific function. 

· Lastly, a self-starter: once you have a clear guidance and direction, you don’t need to be hand-held to get to a solution or deliverable.

We are seeking a highly experienced technical leader who combines deep application development expertise with hands-on experience leveraging AI-powered tools and agents to transform how software is designed, developed, deployed, and maintained. 

 As a Lead Principal Application Software Engineer, you will serve as a technical subject matter expert, driving application architecture, engineering strategies, and complex technical initiatives across AI-native applications and cloud services. You will lead the design and delivery of scalable, reliable applications while establishing innovative development practices that leverage LLMs, AI agents, and automation throughout the software development lifecycle. 

 The ideal candidate brings extensive Java development experience, strong knowledge of cloud technologies and application architecture, and a demonstrated ability to influence engineering direction across organizational boundaries. This role requires hands-on technical depth, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to lead complex initiatives that improve developer productivity, software quality, and application delivery at scale.

- Lead the architecture, design, development, and implementation of complex, scalable cloud-based applications and services. 

- Serve as a technical subject matter expert, influencing application architecture, engineering decisions, and AI-native development practices across teams. 

- Drive the adoption and integration of AI-powered coding tools, LLMs, and AI agents throughout the software development lifecycle. 

- Translate complex business and technical requirements into application architectures, detailed specifications, and executable engineering solutions. 

- Establish technical approaches for AI-assisted code generation, review, testing, debugging, deployment, and ongoing application maintenance. 

- Lead complex application development initiatives spanning multiple teams, resolving architectural challenges, integration dependencies, and implementation risks. 

- Design and develop Java-based applications, APIs, and services using modern cloud development practices. 

- Evaluate emerging AI developer technologies and identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity, software quality, and development efficiency. 

- Establish engineering standards and best practices for validating AI-generated code, ensuring application security, reliability, performance, and maintainability. 

- Partner with engineering, product, and cross-functional leaders to align application capabilities with customer requirements and organizational priorities. 

- Advise engineering leadership on technical trade-offs, application architecture, and opportunities to scale AI-native development capabilities. 

- Mentor engineers, promote technical knowledge sharing, and influence software engineering practices across teams. 
 Basic Qualifications 
 
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 

- 10+ years of experience in software engineering, application development, or related technical disciplines, including experience leading complex engineering initiatives. 

- Deep expertise in Java development, application architecture, and large-scale production software systems. 

- Extensive experience designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining scalable cloud-based applications and services. 

- Hands-on experience leveraging AI-assisted coding tools, LLMs, and AI agents across the software development lifecycle. 

- Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including object-oriented design, APIs, testing, debugging, security, reliability, and maintainability. 

- Experience developing applications using cloud technologies, distributed systems, and modern software development frameworks. 

- Demonstrated experience leading complex application development initiatives and influencing architectural decisions across multiple engineering teams. 

- Experience translating ambiguous business and technical requirements into scalable application designs and working software solutions. 

- Strong technical judgment and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs and resolve complex application development challenges. 

- Ability to influence technical decisions and collaborate effectively with senior engineering leaders and cross-functional stakeholders. 

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to technical and executive audiences. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
- Experience establishing or scaling AI-native application development practices across engineering teams or organizations. 

- Experience with agentic coding workflows, LLM-powered developer tools, or AI-assisted software development and delivery automation. 

- Experience developing enterprise applications, microservices, REST APIs, or distributed cloud applications. 

- Familiarity with Java frameworks such as Spring Boot, along with modern application development patterns and integration technologies. 

- Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, containerization, and application deployment automation.

About Us

 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

 Available Locations: Austin, TX | Washington D.C. | Lisbon, Portugal or London, UK (Hybrid)

 About the Role 

 Our team’s core mission is to enable developers to do what they do best — build powerful applications. We believe they should be able to do this without having to think or worry about infrastructure, scaling, or performance. While Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare’s solution to serverless computing, handles the infrastructure part, there’s so much more that goes into enabling developers to do their jobs. Developer experience plays a critical role in the success of developers using our platform, so it is our team’s goal to make authoring and testing on our platform easy to understand, accessible, and fun! If this excites you, come join our team of talented engineers that enables developers all around the world to build low-latency planet-scale applications for the Internet and the Web!

 About the Department 

 Our team is part of Cloudflare's Emerging Technology and Incubation (ETI) group, where new, bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. As the Workers Authoring and Testing team, we develop and maintain tools and packages within a larger collection of developer resources for one of ETIs most successful endeavors so far, Cloudflare Workers. 

 What you'll do 

 As a member of the Workers Authoring and Testing team, you will put yourself in the shoes of a developer, and use your understanding of software engineering, Web and Internet technologies, and modern JS frameworks to propose, evaluate, and implement innovative technical solutions that create and improve the development experience on the Cloudflare Workers development platform. - Converge existing tools and systems to simplify our product portfolio and increase quality and cohesion of the development experience

- Help feature teams craft their public JavaScript/TypeScript APIs

- Contribute to internal and public-facing technical documentation

- Support the health and availability of services by being part of an on-call rotation

- Collaborate with engineers across Cloudflare, and contribute at many layers of the stack 

- Help implement metrics and dashboards to monitor operational health after projects ship

- Leverage your creativity and developer prowess to seek out new ways to improve the platform

 About you 

 We want you to love it here! This role is a good fit for you if you are: 

- Excited by the idea of helping application developers be successful

- Experienced with JavaScript and TypeScript

- Passionate about development tools, libraries, frameworks, and workflows

- Enthusiastic about untangling and re-architecting complex distributed systems to improve efficiency and simplify future development

- Able to distill developer pain points into a smaller number of root causes

- Excited to own your work from early discussions and onward

- Naturally curious and eager to take steps to learn something new

You want to join a team that upholds a culture of support, open and honest communication, and vulnerability, and that values collaboration over heroism. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to the highest standard

jobs.jd:
Job Description 
 The Opportunity 
 Adobe is reimagining the future of creativity — where generative AI, intelligent agents, and human imagination work hand in hand. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, Agentic Product, you will be a key technical contributor for Adobe's up-and-coming AI-native experience that brings generative models, creative intelligence, and decades of differentiated Adobe capabilities together for hundreds of millions of creators. You will own hands-on buildout of the agent across the full stack and across Adobe's target platforms, from desktop and mobile to web and embedded surfaces. You will help reshape the way the team works in the age of agentic engineering. And you will be getting in on the ground floor to help shape the team and its practices. 
 This is a rare opportunity to build the engineering foundations of Adobe's soon-to-be most visible AI product — from model integration and agentic reasoning patterns, to production infrastructure and cross-platform delivery. The right person brings deep, hands-on full-stack expertise, proven experience shipping agentic systems, a genuine enthusiasm for transforming how engineering itself is done with AI tools like Claude Code and Codex, and the craft to write production-quality code that holds up over time. 
 What you'll do 
 
- Own full-stack implementation across Adobe's Agentic Product — from LLM integration and agentic reasoning layers, to API surfaces, client runtimes, and platform-specific delivery on desktop, mobile, and web. 
 
- Contribute to the production buildout of the agent: translating prototype-quality capabilities into robust, scalable, maintainable systems that meet Adobe's quality and reliability bar for a large, diverse audience. 
 
- Drive hands-on implementation of high-leverage components — including model orchestration, tool use, multi-step task execution, context and memory management, and agent evaluation infrastructure. 
 
- Champion the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices — using tools like Claude Code, Codex, and emerging agentic development platforms to accelerate implementation, raise code quality, and fundamentally change how the team ships. Model new workflows where AI is a first-class collaborator in the development process. 
 
- Contribute to developer experience: tooling, local development loops, CI/CD ergonomics, and the scaffolding that lets a team move fast and confidently in a fast-moving AI product environment. 
 
- Stay current with the model capabilities ecosystem, evaluating new LLM approaches and frameworks, and contributing recommendations on when and how to adopt them. 
 
- Help build and maintain the evaluation and quality framework for agent behavior — the evals, benchmarks, and systematic feedback loops that allow the team to measure progress and catch regressions as capabilities evolve. 
 
- Partner with Engineering and Product leadership to translate product ambitions into technically grounded delivery — surfacing constraints early, proposing implementation options, and ensuring scope is set based on accurate technical understanding. 
 
- Collaborate across Adobe's platform, infrastructure, data, and security teams to ensure the Agentic Product is built on a foundation that supports guardrails, data protection, observability, and the operational requirements of a product at Adobe's scale. 
 
- Raise the bar for peers on the team by generating excellent code, driving high-signal code review processes, and sharing technical knowledge in agentic engineering. 
 What you'll need to succeed 
 
- Solid, hands-on experience with large language models — including practical fluency with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, context window management, retrieval-augmented generation, and the operational realities of running LLM-backed systems in production. 
 
- Experience building and shipping agentic systems: tool use, multi-step reasoning, agent orchestration frameworks, memory and context persistence, and the failure modes that emerge at each layer. 
 
- Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar — and a track record of integrating these into real development workflows. Enthusiasm for pushing the boundary of what AI-augmented engineering can look like at the frontier. 
 
- Full-stack engineering depth sufficient to contribute across the agent's entire surface area — including backend services, client SDKs, and platform-specific integration patterns for Adobe's target platforms. 
 
- Strong engineering craft: readable, well-structured, production-quality code; opinionated views on testing, local dev ergonomics, and the scaffolding that helps a team stay productive as a codebase grows. 
 
- Clear communication skills — able to discuss technical tradeoffs with PM leads and senior technical stakeholders, flag issues early, and collaborate effectively across disciplines. 
 
- Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where the underlying models, frameworks, and user expectations are all rapidly evolving — strong enough foundations to move fast without building on sand. 
 
- Experience collaborating cross-functionally with product, design, platform, and security teams in the context of shipping user-facing AI products. 
 
- Familiarity with the quality, trust, and reliability requirements of shipping AI features to a large consumer and enterprise audience, including responsible AI considerations specific to generative and agentic systems.

 Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions.  Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

 Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Exchange Platform Performance 

- 
 Optimize order entry, risk, matching and market data processing paths. 

- 
 Identify bottlenecks across order validation, risk checks, matching, execution reporting and market data publication. 

- 
 Improve latency, throughput, jitter and scalability.

 Translate exchange and market-structure requirements into high-performance designs. 

- 
 Evaluate trade-offs between performance, resilience and maintainability. 

 Low-Latency Architecture and Software 

- 
 Design architectures and data flows for latency-critical exchange components. 

- 
 Optimize concurrency, thread scheduling, memory access and data structures. 

- 
 Apply cache-efficient design, memory alignment, allocation avoidance and zero-copy processing. 

- 
 Design lock-free or wait-free algorithms and high-performance queues. 

- 
 Reduce unnecessary processing, copying, serialization and context switching. 

 Protocol, Network and System Optimization 

- 
 Design and optimize binary protocols and communication between gateways, risk engines, matching engines and market data components.

 Improve serialization, IPC, messaging, buffering, batching and backpressure handling. 

- 
 Work with FIX, FIXP, SBE and proprietary exchange protocols.

 Evaluate technologies such as Aeron, TIBCO FTL, DPDK and Solarflare OpenOnload. 

- 
 Optimize NIC queues, interrupts, packet processing and memory buffers.

- 
 Collaborate with Infrastructure Engineering on Linux, firmware, BIOS, NIC and server configuration. 

 Performance Measurement

 Establish representative benchmarks for exchange workloads. 

- 
 Measure component and end-to-end latency, including p50, p99, p99.9 and p99.99. 

- 
 Build profiling, tracing and automated performance-regression capabilities.

 Investigate latency spikes, jitter and throughput limitations. 

- 
 Reproduce production performance issues and translate findings into engineering improvements. 

- 
 Use reliable performance evidence to guide architecture and protocol decisions.

 10+ years of experience as a software engineer.

 5+ years working with trading technology, exchange infrastructure, HFT, market making or financial-market infrastructure.

 Experience building or optimizing production trading systems with latency below 100 microseconds. 

- 
 Experience with order entry gateways, market data distribution, risk engines or matching engines. 

- 
 Experience profiling latency-critical systems and analyzing latency distributions. 

- 
 Ability to investigate performance across application, protocol, network, operating-system and hardware layers. 

- 
 Strong hands-on technical expertise in: 

- 
 C++ and Java 

- 
 Linux systems 

- 
 Networking 

- 
 Concurrency 

- 
 Low-latency architecture 

- 
 Memory optimization 

- 
 Lock-free systems 

- 
 Binary protocols 

- 
 Tail-latency optimization

 Experience with FIX, FIXP, SBE or proprietary exchange protocols. 

- 
 Experience with Aeron, TIBCO FTL or similar messaging technologies. 

- 
 Experience with DPDK, Solarflare OpenOnload or equivalent user-space networking. 

- 
 Knowledge of SPSC/MPSC queues, NUMA, huge pages, CPU pinning and cache-line optimization. 

- 
 Familiarity with Linux perf, eBPF, flame graphs and hardware performance counters.

About Anthropic 

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

 Anthropic's products are growing fast in reach and complexity. Every new model, product, and channel brings problems no one predicted. We want to catch each issue as early as possible, get customers unblocked fast, and fix the root cause. The best experience is one where a customer never has to ask for help.

 We are building a Support Technology engineering team to solve what stands between a customer and Claude, whether they want to use it but can't or are unhappy with their experience. That covers individual users, businesses, and customers who reach Claude through partners.

 Our goal is a better product experience for everyone who uses Claude. We make it easy for customers to get help and talk to us, through Claude itself and via human specialists with the tools to solve their problems. We also determine why they needed help and fix the cause in the product.

 Billing is a good example. When a charge is confusing, a payment fails, or a plan doesn't unlock, a customer should be able to reach us and get it resolved in one conversation. Then we want to learn why it happened and change the product, whether that's the subscription flow, the payment error, or the invoice, so the next customer never has to ask.

 As one of the team's early engineers, you will set the technical direction and build the core systems behind this work. We expect Claude to handle more of each case over time, from diagnosing an issue to resolving it to flagging the product fix behind it. Success means customers run into fewer problems, get them truly solved when they do, and are happy with the help they receive, whether it comes from Claude or a person.

 This is a hands-on role with high leverage. You will write a lot of code and lead across teams, since many fixes belong to other product teams. You will partner with our Product Manager, the Product Support team, and product engineering teams such as Billing Platform.

Key responsibilities

- Improve the product experience at the root: Build agents that spot where customers keep getting stuck and find the root cause, then ship the fix or drive it with the owning team until customers stop running into the problem

- Make our support agents reliable first responders: Build the tools, APIs, and safe, audited workflows our Claude-powered support agents use for common fixes, with evals, guardrails, and clean handoffs to people, and measure whether customers' problems actually get solved

- Build the platform foundations: Create a reliable support platform that scales with our growth, including the experience and tools for customers and specialists, and the data that shows what customers are running into and whether our changes help

- Support enterprise and partner channels: Extend support to business customers, admins, and partner-sold customers, including cases that start outside our own products

- Raise the bar and build with Claude: Set standards for reliability, observability, testing, and rollouts, mentor engineers, and use Claude heavily in your own work

- Deep backend and distributed systems skills, including APIs, data models, event-driven systems, and third-party integrations

- Experience building production software, including technical lead roles on multi-team projects

- Experience building systems where correctness, access control, and auditability matter

- A clear vision for how capable models like Claude can improve customer support, and motivation to build it

- Judgment about when to ship a simple fix and when to invest in a platform

- Track record of leading without formal authority and getting other teams to own and ship fixes

Preferred qualifications

Lead Platform Engineer - Network Operations

Overview:

jobs.jd:
Join us in building the future of finance.

 Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

 About the team + role 

 We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

 The Capacity & Efficiency Engineering team builds the software that manages, governs, and reduces Robinhood's AWS cloud spend across compute, databases, and storage, operating at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, data engineering, and FinOps. We own the full lifecycle of cloud cost, from attribution and forecasting to automation that rightsizes infrastructure at fleet scale and keeps a bursty, latency-sensitive trading platform both reliable and cost-effective. Our work carries CEO-level visibility, has already driven millions of dollars in annualized savings, and is delivered in close partnership with Infrastructure, Finance, and product engineering teams across Robinhood.

 As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you will own capacity and efficiency for Robinhood's storage and database fleet, from Aurora clusters to S3 and the caches and volumes in between. You will build the systems that size this fleet to demand: Aurora reader counts and writer sizes set from market hours, declared events, and live load instead of fixed schedules; databases, caches, and volumes rightsized to what they actually use; and S3 data kept in the right storage class, with lifecycle rules that keep growth in check. You will take each from recommendations the Storage team validates to automation that safely applies its own changes in production. This is a 0-to-1 build with measurable impact on reliability at market peaks and on the AWS bill.

 This role is based in our Bellevue, WA office , with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week .

 At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

 What you’ll do 

- Build forecast-driven capacity planning for the storage and database fleet, turning traffic history, load tests, and known events (market open, earnings, IPOs, promotions) into plans that scale up ahead and back down after, with an expiry on every temporary capacity hold

- Design and build a capacity planner for Aurora that sets reader counts and writer instance sizes from demand and load signals (IOPS, CPU, connections, replica lag), replacing fixed scaling schedules

- Rightsize databases, caches, and block storage (RDS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, EBS) on instance size, provisioned IOPS and throughput, and idle capacity, and keep them right-sized as load changes

- Own S3 efficiency at scale: storage class and Intelligent-Tiering strategy, lifecycle and retention policies, noncurrent versions and incomplete uploads, and request costs, using Storage Lens and inventory data

- Take every recommendation to closed-loop automation with guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback, in partnership with the Storage infrastructure team, handling constraints such as AWS capacity shortages, fallback instance types, and connection pooling

- Measure outcomes in cost and reliability (savings against baseline, forecast error, utilization, capacity left behind after events) and share our forecasts with the pod rightsizing system so compute and storage scale together

 What you bring 

- Deep hands-on experience operating AWS storage and databases at scale, especially Aurora or RDS (MySQL or PostgreSQL) and S3, including replication, read scaling, storage classes, and lifecycle management

- Capacity planning and forecasting experience: modeling time-series demand, load testing, and translating traffic into instance counts, sizes, and storage growth

- A track record of rightsizing infrastructure from utilization data (CPU, memory, IOPS, throughput, bytes stored) without hurting latency or availability

- Strong Python or Go engineering, with experience building automation that safely modifies production infrastructure (guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback built in), not just systems that observe and report

- Familiarity with AWS storage and database pricing (S3 storage classes and requests, Aurora I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Reserved Instances) is a strong plus

- Experience with bursty, event-driven workloads (trading, payments, ticketing) or with Spark, Airflow, or Kubernetes is a plus

 This is a greenfield opportunity to design and build new automation services and secure host execution capabilities from the ground up. Your work will connect durable, fleet-wide orchestration with reliable database and operating system operations on individual hosts, improving availability, consistency, and operational safety while minimizing customer disruption.

 You will independently drive complex projects from architecture through production operation, collaborating with database, infrastructure, and security teams. As a technical leader, you will guide design decisions, deliver robust software, mentor engineers, and improve engineering and operational practices across the broader organization.

 Mentors teams and leads the architecture of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems. Identifies and removes performance/scalability bottlenecks for hyper‑scale workloads; defines scalability requirements with stakeholders; and designs elastic, high‑impact systems while advancing innovation in data plane platforms. Engineers and oversees fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable designs; optimizes resilience mechanisms (load‑shedding, throttling, rate‑limiting); and sets SLO‑aligned durability and availability standards across dependent services. Establishes KPIs and advanced telemetry; applies formal verification for complex features; and develops robust replication/synchronization strategies. Advises and leads resolution of complex production issues, sets operational readiness and SOP standards, and directs incident response and RCAs. Architects advanced security controls, drives remediation and compliance, and delivers enterprise‑level automation (IaC) and change strategies enabling safe, automated patching, updates, and rollbacks.

Key Responsibilities
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
–Mentor the team in the architecture and design of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems, ensuring horizontal and vertical scalability and overall performance, including leveraging distributed state management tools. 
–Lead the identification of performance and scalability bottlenecks and recommend solutions to optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to improve performance for hyper-scale systems. 
–Lead collaboration with stakeholders to define system scalability requirements, ensuring the defined requirements meet customer expectations. 
–Leverage deep expertise to design high-impact, interdependent systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down). 
–Drive innovation in the use of data plane platforms. 
–Evaluate whether systems are meeting nonfunctional scalability requirements, and proactively anticipate growing business needs within the business unit.
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
–Design and oversee the implementation of fault-tolerant, interdependent systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing sophisticated redundancy, replication, and automatic failover capabilities. 
–Lead the design and implementation of systems that effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. 
–Guide the optimization of advanced mechanisms to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting. 
–Design interdependent systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), driving standards for availability and durability of other computing services within the organization
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify risks, gaps, or cyclical dependencies in running, interdependent systems. 
–Drive the creation and customization of highly complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms, proactively ensuring system health and reliability.
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
–Maintain expertise in industry standards for verifying correctness and apply existing techniques to interdependent systems. 
–Formally verify complex features (e.g., via TLA+) to ensure system design correctness for various interdependent systems.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, CloudWatch Alarms
jobs.jd:
Do you want to build the system that tells millions of engineers the moment something goes wrong? As a Software Development Engineer on Amazon CloudWatch Alarms, you will design and operate the service that continuously evaluates customer metrics and logs, and acts on them in real time — notifying on-call teams, scaling fleets, and recovering resources, often while the rest of a customer's infrastructure is under stress. When our customers have an incident, our alarms have to be right and on time — that is the problem you will work on every day.

CloudWatch is the observability service of Amazon Web Services (AWS), used by developers, site reliability engineers (SREs), system operators, and IT managers to monitor their applications and infrastructure. CloudWatch processes quadrillions of metric observations every month and continuosly evaluates millions of alarms, with tight latency and correctness requirements.

This role is based in Dublin, Ireland.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Design, build and operate highly available distributed systems that evaluate customer alarms and trigger notifications and automated actions across AWS.

Deliver new alarming capabilities — from composite alarms to anomaly detection — from design through launch in every AWS Region.

Dive deep into operational issues, identify root causes, and put fixes in place that prevent them from recurring.

Collaborate with partner teams across CloudWatch and AWS to turn customer requirements into designs and incremental, safe deliverables.

Mentor junior engineers and share what you learn through design and code reviews.

A day in the life
You might start the day investigating why a customer's alarm changed state later than expected, then join a design review for a new capability that lets customers monitor thousands of resources with a single alarm. In the afternoon, you could profile the evaluation path to cut latency and cost. AI coding assistants and agents are part of how you work every day — you'll use them to explore unfamiliar code, prototype ideas, write tests, and speed up investigations, freeing up more of your time for design and hard problems.

This role includes participating in an on-call rotation for the services the team owns. We don't like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we build our systems to be fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so we don't get paged for the same issue twice.

About the team
CloudWatch Alarms is how AWS customers learn that something needs their attention. Our customers range from startups to the largest enterprises, and teams across Amazon rely on our alarms to keep their own services healthy. Our vision is for every alarm to be timely, accurate and actionable at any scale. Over the next few years we're focused on making alarms easier to set up across large, changing environments and smarter about what truly needs a human's attention — and you will help shape that roadmap.

Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we've built an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior engineers enjoy mentoring engineers at every stage, including those from non-traditional backgrounds, through one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We assign projects based on what will help you grow into a well-rounded engineer, so you can take on more complex work over time.

Basic qualifications:
- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Hands on programming skills in at least one of the following: Rust, Go, Java, C++, Python

Preferred qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Open-source enthusiasm and contributions (e.g. a GitHub portfolio, or contributions to projects such as OpenTelemetry)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Job Description 

 Purpose of the role 
 
 To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
 
 Accountabilities 
 
- Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.

- Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.

- Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.

- Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

- Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.

- Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.
 
 Assistant Vice President Expectations 
 
- To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.

- Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes

- If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

- OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

- Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.

- Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.

- Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.

- Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.

- Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.

- Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.

- Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.

- Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
 
 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

 Join Barclays as a Lead Engineer - AI Platform role, where to design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.

 To be successful in this role, you should have below skills: 
 
- Cloud-native distributed systems (3+ yrs) designing and owning platform subsystems end-to-end

- Strong Python (FastAPI/asyncio) or Go/Java — production APIs and microservices

- AWS at scale + Kubernetes — EKS, Bedrock, IAM, RDS/Aurora, deployment strategies, HPA

- GenAI/Agentic AI — LangGraph/LangChain or Google ADK, MCP/A2A, RAG pipelines, LLM integration
 
 Some other highly valued skills may include below: 
 
- Envoy Proxy or API gateway platforms

- OPA/Rego policy-as-code

- AI safety controls — guardrails, prompt injection defence, content filtering

- Zero Trust / identity systems — EntraID, OAuth2/OIDC
 
 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

 This role is based in Bengaluru and Pune office.

jobs.jd:
About Us 

 Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

 Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

 Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

 Key Responsibilities 

- 
 Review existing security policies and procedures for logical completeness, consistency across provisions, and alignment with local regulatory requirements. 

- 
 Guide and oversee business teams in completing Control Self-Assessments (CSAs). 

- 
 Lead the annual security compliance audit for the core platform, including audit evidence collection, remediation tracking, and validation of remediation outcomes. 

- 
 Support security certification initiatives, such as ISO 27701 and ISO 42001. 

- 
 Undertake other security governance initiatives, including but not limited to: 

- 
 Configure, manage, and review access permissions for information systems across the Group, ensuring that access assignments are compliant and appropriate. 

- 
 Conduct regular reviews of system permissions and access controls to ensure access is granted only to appropriate personnel and roles. 

- 
 Continuously improve access-management processes and policies to enhance efficiency and security. 

- 
 Conduct periodic access-security risk assessments to identify and address potential risks. 

 Qualifications 

- 
 Bachelor’s degree or above; a major in Computer Science, Information Security , Network Engineering, or a related field is preferred. 

- 
 Three to five years of experience in system security auditing, access management, security governance, or information security within a large enterprise or corporate group. 

- 
 Familiarity with common identity and access management tools, such as LDAP and Okta , as well as access-control policies. 

- 
 Good knowledge of information security standards, regulations, and compliance requirements, such as ISO 27001, GDPR , SOC 2, and ISO 27701. 

- 
 Fluency in English, with the ability to read and write technical documents and communicate effectively in English. 

- 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a collaborative mindset. 

- 
 Excellent communication skills and experience working across departments. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

- 
 Relevant information security certifications, such as CISSP, CISM, or CISA. 

- 
 Experience managing access permissions on cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Tencent Cloud. 

 Why Join Us 
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

jobs.jd:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

 We're looking for talented Senior Software Engineers to join our Consumer Revenue squads, the teams at the heart of premium experiences at Discord. You’ll be building out a premium Discord for millions of subscribers, focusing on surfaces such as Nitro, shop, boosting, user identity, and more. Your work will be vital in delivering a high-value premium experience, without compromising the core experience for our free users. You’ll be a key driver in generating the revenue that fuels Discord’s mission.

 In this product engineering role, you'll collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Data Science, Design, Marketing, and other functions to create best-in-class consumer experiences. Your work will cover the full breadth of the technical stack, from backend data modeling, through business logic in APIs, to polished, user-facing interfaces. You’ll be supported by infrastructure, platform, and product teams on your mission to build the best premium Discord.

 What You'll Be Doing 

- Build and improve premium Discord experiences such as Nitro, shop, boosting, user identity, and more.

- Own projects end to end by partnering with Product to refine requirements, create technical specs, and work closely with Design to execute and deliver best-in-class user experiences.

- Work with a team of full-stack engineers to ship new features across Web, Android, and iOS.

- Lead complex initiatives from conception to completion, thriving in ambiguous environments.

- Rapidly prototype new features and synthesize insights through experimentation.

 What you should have 

- 5+ years of software engineering experience. You’re a key technical contributor to your team and have led sizable projects which have had a big impact on your team’s roadmap.

- Full-stack proficiency. You are an expert in React/React Native with a solid grasp of Python backend development. We work primarily in the web (React, TypeScript), mobile (React Native, with a small amount of Kotlin, Objective-C, and Swift), and backend (Python).

- Product sense. You maintain a high degree of empathy for your internal and external users, and seek feedback from them about your work. You have an eye for what changes can bring a product from good to great.

- Ownership mentality. You thrive with autonomy, take initiative to drive projects forward, and are comfortable with ambiguity.

- Pragmatic approach. You find incremental approaches to solving complex problems, enjoy rapidly prototyping solutions, value your autonomy and operate with high integrity.

- Performance-focused mindset. You have a solid understanding of React performance and client-server performance optimization, and a commitment to maintaining high-performance standards.

- Growth mindset. You view challenges and mistakes as learning opportunities while building upon your successes. You push yourself and those around you to continuously improve.

 Bonus Points 

- Experience working on teams focused on growth, particularly in revenue generation, product monetization, or user engagement systems

- Strong track record of driving measurable impact through experimentation and data-driven decision making

- Demonstrated success in attracting new users, driving engagement, sustaining long-term retention, and optimizing consumer-facing features

- Experience with performance optimization at scale, particularly for consumer-facing applications

- Interest or passion for the Discord platform

 Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties). Relocation assistance may be available. For this role, there is no formal requirement to work from the office. 
 The base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. This position will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) plan; life and disability insurance; paid time off; and paid parental leave. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits. Applications for this role are accepted on an ongoing basis. 

 Base Salary
 $196,000 — $245,000 USD 

 Why Discord? 

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away! 

 Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know.

 Please see our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy for details regarding Discord’s collection and usage of personal information relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking HERE.

jobs.jd:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Businesses need a clear, reliable way to work with their vendors, from collecting information during onboarding to keeping vendor records accurate as they purchase and pay. Vendors need a straightforward way to provide details and stay connected with the businesses they serve. Ramp’s Vendor Management & Portal team builds the systems behind those experiences.



We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to make vendor information easier to collect, connect, and use across Ramp. You’ll work on services that support vendor profiles, onboarding requests, and the vendor portal, where identity, permissions, and data accuracy matter. You’ll own meaningful projects from design through launch and partner with product, design, and other engineering teams to make these workflows dependable for both businesses and vendors.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and build backend services and APIs for vendor profiles, onboarding, and portal workflows.

 - Improve how vendor records and portal accounts are matched and connected, reducing duplicate work and making shared information more reliable.

 - Build workflows for collecting and updating vendor information, including payment and tax details, with clear permissions and accurate data handling.

 - Make vendor data available consistently across the products that depend on it, including procurement and bill pay.

 - Own projects from problem definition and technical design through launch, monitoring, and iteration.

 - Raise the quality of the team’s systems through thoughtful design reviews, code reviews, and mentorship.




WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - Experience designing, building, and operating production backend systems, including APIs, data models, and asynchronous workflows.

 - Strong judgment about data integrity, access controls, reliability, and the tradeoffs involved in evolving existing systems.

 - A track record of independently leading complex engineering projects from design to production.

 - Product sense and curiosity about how businesses and vendors actually use the workflows you build.

 - Clear communication and a collaborative approach to working across engineering, product, and design.
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with vendor management, procurement, accounts payable, or other business finance workflows.

 - Experience with identity matching, deduplication, or sharing data safely across accounts and products.

 - Experience improving operational visibility and reliability in systems that handle sensitive business information.




BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Health and wellness stipend

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend




UNITED STATES

 - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

 - One Medical annual membership

 - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

 - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

 - Pet insurance

 - In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

 - Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)
   
   


CANADA

 - Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

 - Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

 - Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

 - Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

 - Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health




UNITED KINGDOM

 - Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

 - Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

 - Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

 - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay




REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 


OTHER NOTICES

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @Ramp.com http://Ramp.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.
