Job Description:
 
 The Role 
 In this role on the Privileged Access Management team, your primary responsibility will be to own and operate Fidelity’s HashiCorp Vault application. This is an enterprise-class installation providing secrets management services to over 5,000 business unit applications. You will design, develop, and support new and improved access management capabilities that meet Fidelity’s stringent cybersecurity policies and requirements. You will administer critical production environments including implementation of monitoring, upgrades, performance & capacity improvements, certifying disaster readiness, improving CI/CD with process automation, and analyzing key metrics and trends. We operate in an Agile framework where you will have an opportunity to participate in sprint planning to provide prioritization, and realistic and achievable estimates. You will also contribute towards continuous improvement efforts aimed at increasing the efficiency and velocity of the team.
 
 The Expertise and Skills You Bring 
 
- 
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Systems Networking, Information Systems/Science, or a related discipline

- 5+ years of experience and demonstrated expertise with administration and operation of the HashiCorp Vault application is a requirement for this role

- You have systems and application management experience on Linux/UNIX platforms

- You have experience with cloud architecture and have built applications in, or migrated applications to, Amazon Web Services AWS or Microsoft Azure

- You have experience with networking, firewalls, and load balancers

- You have experience building automated pipelines and deploying with CI/CD technologies such as Jenkins, Git, Ansible, Chef, Artifactory, AWS Cloud Formation Templates, Terraform, EC2, Lambda, Docker/Kubernetes, and KMS

- You develop advanced, customized workflows and automated processes for/with vendor applications

- You have strong scripting & automation skills, specifically in Python and Ansible

- You have excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present to both technical and business audiences

- You have demonstrated experience in leading small technical teams

- You have the ability to independently perform systems design & architecture work to satisfy technical objectives and meet business requirements

 The Team 
 In this position you will join Fidelity’s Enterprise Cybersecurity business unit as a member of the Privileged Access Management team. We are a dynamic, high visibility team that provides a variety of access management services to all of Fidelity’s business units. The Privileged Access Management team is comprised of engineers located in the US, Ireland, and India. We leverage an Agile operating model to install, configure, operate, and maintain a set of in-house and vendor applications providing a multitude of access management capabilities to the firm. We are a DevOps team that engages in systems engineering, software engineering, and production services support.

You will develop production-quality components while building depth in cloud platforms, distributed data systems, scientific workflows, and AI-enabled services. You will combine strong software engineering skills with a practical understanding of bioinformatics or computational science across areas such as genomics, plant biology, or generative biology. 

 You are expected to work at Oracle’s London or Reading offices 4 days a week for this role. The role will also require you to frequently travel to Oxford.

What You’ll Do  

- Design, develop, test, and maintain software components for cloud platform services.  

- Implement backend services, APIs, data-ingestion and processing components, workflow integrations, automation, and operational tooling.  

- Work with other engineers and product managers to understand requirements and translate customer scenarios into well-defined software features.  

- Contribute to rapid iteration by investigating customer feedback, troubleshooting issues, and improving product functionality.  

- Write clean, maintainable, secure, and well-tested code using established OCI engineering practices.  

- Build unit, integration, and functional tests; participate in performance and resilience testing.  

- Add logging, metrics, telemetry, health checks, and alerts to improve service observability.  

- Help investigate, debug, and resolve service issues in development and production environments.  

- Participate in code reviews, design discussions, documentation, and engineering-planning activities.  

- Automate repeatable tasks related to deployment, configuration, testing, and service operations.  

- 

 What You’ll Bring  

- 3+ years of professional software development experience, including experience delivering production software or services.  

- Domain awareness of bioinformatics or computational life sciences, such as genetics, genomics, plant biology, or generative biology. 

- Understanding of scientific computing workflows and the challenges associated with large datasets, reproducibility, metadata, provenance, and compute resource requirements 

- Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Java, Go, or Python.  

- Experience developing backend applications, cloud-native services, distributed-system components, data-processing applications, or workflow systems.  

- Ability to independently deliver well-scoped features and components, with guidance on broader technical design and prioritization.  

- Experience working collaboratively in an Agile or iterative software-development environment.  

- Curiosity and willingness to learn rapidly from customers, product managers, applied scientists, and senior engineers.  

- Familiarity with REST APIs, source control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, containers, and cloud services.  

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.  

- 

 Responsibilities  

 Software Development  

- Implement features and services from defined requirements and technical designs.  

- Develop maintainable code, APIs, data-processing components, integrations, and automated tests.  

- Debug defects and improve the performance, reliability, and usability of owned components.  

- Participate in code reviews and apply feedback to improve technical quality.  

 Customer-Focused Delivery  

- Support the team in understanding customer workflows, technical requirements, and feedback.  

- Help translate feedback into actionable engineering tasks and product improvements.  

- Contribute to fast, iterative delivery while maintaining engineering discipline and quality.  

- Learn the scientific and technical domain and identify opportunities to make solutions reusable across customers.  

- 

 Reliability, Security, and Operations

 Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, microservices, distributed data systems, event-driven architectures, or workflow orchestration.  

- Exposure to data engineering, data platforms, scientific data, data pipelines, metadata management, or data governance.  

- Exposure to AI/ML platforms, model training, model-serving systems, RAG, evaluation harnesses, AI agents, MCP, or enterprise AI integrations.  

- Experience supporting scientific, research, life-sciences, or enterprise platform workloads.

About Us

 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

 Available Locations: Atlanta, GA; Austin, TX; Denver, CO; New York City; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; Washington D.C.; Toronto, Canada

 About the role 

 Many of Cloudflare’s critical internal services run on Kubernetes. These services include those responsible for Cloudflare’s control plane and APIs, data analytics and other internal tools used to manage our global network. These Kubernetes platforms are purpose-built from the ground up and run on bare metal Linux in different regions around the world. The scale we work at involves tens of thousands of containers and terabits per second of network traffic. The team takes pride in knowing this platform helps run parts of the global Internet.

 As an engineer on the Kubernetes platform team, you'll be building the tools to help engineers deploy and operate the services that make Cloudflare work. Our mission is to provide a reliable and flexible platform to help product teams release new software efficiently and safely. The role includes both software engineering and DevOps operational responsibilities.

 Responsibilities 

- Design scalable and resilient systems that can keep up with company growth.

- Work with application teams to understand their needs and challenges, and help them choose the best way to architect their systems to run well in our Kubernetes environment.

- Harden the platform against security threats, noisy neighbours, and accidents.

- Improve the efficiency of our use of resources such as CPU, memory, bandwidth, and storage.

- Help respond to, resolve, and prevent incidents impacting the platform or our users.

- Contribute back to the open source community. Some of our favorite open source projects include: Envoy, Contour, Consul, etcd, cdk8s, Cloudprober, Calico, Ceph, Rook, KubeVirt, and more.

 Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience 

- Experience managing production Kubernetes clusters.

- Experience operating systems on-premise at scale in roles such as SRE, systems design or architecture.

- Excellent debugging skills in a Linux environment.

- Knowledge of how container runtimes work inside of Linux (isolation, storage, and networking).

- A firm grasp of IP networking including routing and iptables/nftables.

- Ability to work with codebases in Go, TypeScript, and Bash/shell.

- The ability to break down complex problems into smaller pieces, provide options, talk through trade-offs, build consensus, and drive the effort to solve the problem.

 Bonus Points 

- Familiarity with building platforms across multiple zones and regions as the foundation for other teams to build distributed highly-available applications.

- Experience with configuration management frameworks such as SaltStack or Ansible.

- Experience with continuous deployment tooling like ArgoCD and Argo Rollouts.

- Operational/administrator experience with etcd, Ceph, Rook, KubeVirt, CNIs, ClusterAPI, Envoy, and/or Contour.

- Experience as a user of Prometheus, Elasticsearch/Kibana, Vault, Redis, and/or Consul.

Compensation

 Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

- For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000

- For Denver based hires: Estimated annual salary of $168,000 - $231,000

- For New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000

- For Seattle based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000

- For Washington D.C. based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000

- For Toronto, Canada based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $206,000

Applications will be accepted until December 25, 2026.

Equity

 This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.

Benefits

 Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

 Health & Welfare Benefits

- Medical/Rx Insurance

- Dental Insurance

- Vision Insurance

- Flexible Spending Accounts

- Commuter Spending Accounts

- Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

- On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

jobs.jd:
Your work days are brighter here. 

 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

 About the Team 

The Enterprise Security Engineering team is the frontline of Workday's enterprise defense, ensuring that our global corporate environment remains secure, resilient, and ready to support the pace of innovation across the company. We sit at the intersection of endpoint infrastructure, developer enablement, and security automation — protecting Workday's corporate fleet while empowering our engineering community to build and ship with confidence. 

Our work spans endpoint privilege management, endpoint detection and response (EDR), SaaS security posture management (SSPM), and the governance of developer tools and emerging AI technologies. In the year ahead, the team will focus on expanding agentic automation pipelines, evolving our application control frameworks to support safe AI adoption, and deepening cross-pillar integration between endpoint, SaaS posture, and threat detection systems.

What makes this team special is our commitment to engineering excellence and to each other. We invest deeply in mentorship and talent development, helping engineers at every level grow their technical depth and take ownership of their domains. If you enjoy solving meaningful security challenges alongside a collaborative, forward-thinking group, this team is for you.
 About the Role 

 As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer on the Enterprise Security Engineering team, you will bridge strategic architecture and operational delivery.  The Opportunity 
 
 Join Adobe’s distinguished team as a Senior Backend Engineer – Cloud Platform based in San Jose, CA.  What you need to succeed 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, 5-10 years experience, or equivalent.

- Extensive DevOps experience, with a detailed understanding of deployment and monitoring methods for cloud-native software. 

- A proactive approach—you take initiative, anticipate challenges, and don’t wait to be told what to do. 

- AI-first development experience. 

 What will help you stand out from the crowd 

- Experience with Chef, API development, and Python development. 

- Experience building and deploying microservices using tools like Docker and Kubernetes. 

- Outstanding problem-solving skills and a proven ability to successfully implement ambitious projects.

jobs.jd:
Our Purpose 
 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 
 Title and Summary 

Lead Software Engineer

Position Overview

The Business Experimentation and Optimization (BE&O) teams within Mastercard’s Services organization are building industry-leading software that empowers business users around the world to make data-driven decisions through advanced analytics and experimentation. As we expand our product offerings and modernize our technology stack, we are reimagining how we deliver scalable, cloud-native solutions to our clients.

We are seeking a hands-on, technically strong Lead Software Engineer to drive the architecture, design, and development of our next-generation experimentation platform. In this role, you will help define and evolve system architecture and non-functional requirements—such as scalability, performance, security, and reliability—ensuring our solutions meet the highest engineering standards. As a technical leader, you will guide cross-functional teams in building scalable services, APIs, and analytical capabilities that power our platform, leveraging technologies like Databricks and cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure. You will collaborate closely with your immediate team and partner with other development teams across programs to align on shared goals, define cross-cutting initiatives, and deliver cohesive, enterprise-grade solutions. You will also mentor engineers, work across global time zones, and champion engineering excellence through best practices in software development, observability, and continuous delivery.

Our teams are small, agile, and empowered to choose the processes that work best for their goals. Every engineer contributes to the full development lifecycle—from ideation and design to implementation and testing—fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement.

We are seeking passionate and talented technologists who share our vision of empowering customers to make smarter, data-driven decisions. Join us and help shape the future growth of our team.

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is the global technology company behind the world’s fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, and a technology innovation lab. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you.

At Mastercard Services, you will serve as a senior technical leader and hands-on engineer for BE&O’s next-generation experimentation and analytics platform. Lead the technical design and delivery of complex, data-intensive software solutions that enable advanced analytics, experimentation, and data-driven decisioning for Mastercard clients.
Define and drive technical strategy for modernization initiatives, including evolution of legacy systems toward scalable, cloud-native, API-driven, and service-oriented architectures.
Lead system design across multiple levels of detail, including platform architecture, high-level design, detailed technical design, integration patterns, non-functional requirements, and implementation approach.
Serve as a hands-on technical contributor, designing, coding, testing, debugging, and delivering production-quality software across the full engineering lifecycle.
Build and evolve scalable services, APIs, data pipelines, and analytical capabilities using modern engineering practices, cloud platforms, and data technologies such as AWS, Azure, Databricks, Spark/PySpark, and related frameworks.
Partner closely with product managers, engineering teams, architects, data scientists, QA, security, and operations teams to translate business and functional requirements into robust technical solutions.
Coordinate and lead technical execution across globally distributed engineering teams, ensuring alignment across regions, time zones, dependencies, design decisions, and delivery milestones.
Drive architecture and design reviews, code reviews, technical decision-making, and engineering tradeoff discussions to ensure solutions are secure, resilient, observable, performant, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
Identify opportunities to improve platform scalability, reliability, developer productivity, operational readiness, and speed of delivery through modernization, automation, reusable patterns, and engineering best practices.
Provide technical mentorship to junior and mid-level engineers through design guidance, code review, pairing, knowledge sharing, and modeling strong engineering judgment.
Navigate ambiguity in complex initiatives by clarifying technical direction, decomposing large problems, identifying risks, and driving alignment across stakeholders.
Champion a culture of engineering excellence, continuous improvement, ownership, collaboration, and high-quality delivery across the team and partner organizations.

Strong hands-on experience designing and building distributed systems, microservices, RESTful APIs, and cloud-native applications.

 The ideal candidate combines strong full-stack engineering fundamentals with a systems mindset for reliability and scale, and has spent meaningful hands-on time (1–2 years) building AI-agentified applications not just experimenting with AI tools, but shipping agentic features in production. We are targeting 8+ years of overall software engineering experience; this is flexible for candidates who demonstrate strong depth across full-stack, distributed systems, and applied AI engineering skills during technical evaluation.

- Build and productionize agentic workflows, LLM-powered automation, and AI-assisted tooling having hands-on experience with these systems.

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

 What is The Role 

 Elastic, the Search AI Company, empowers everyone to find answers in real-time, leveraging all their data at scale, and fueling the potential of businesses and individuals. The Elastic Search AI Platform, trusted by over 50% of the Fortune 500, unifies the precision of search with the intelligence of AI to accelerate impactful results.

 The Software Engineer will join the self-service cloud marketplaces team, driving the expansion of our marketplaces business through existing partnerships and new integrations. This role directly influences the growth and reach of Elastic Cloud across key marketplace ecosystems.

 What You Will Be Doing 

- Working as a full stack engineer, contributing both to the backend and frontend of the product onboarding and trial experience.

- Designing and implementing new scalable features and APIs in our product.

- Working closely with PMs and designers to plan and design the features.

- Implementing new integrations and adding new marketplaces.

- Expand the usage and capabilities of the existing marketplaces.

- Designing and implementing data evolution strategies to manage schema changes without introducing breaking changes.

What You Bring 

- Strong proficiency in React and JavaScript/TypeScript.

- Strong proficiency in Node.js server frameworks like Hapi and Next.js.

- Front-end tech like HTML5, CSS3, and responsive design is in your wheelhouse.

- You know your way around RESTful APIs and async programming.

- If you've dabbled in state management libraries (like NgRx), that's a big bonus.

- Git and other code collaboration tools don't scare you.

- Experience deploying and operationalizing software in production.

- Ability to plan, design, implement, and lead projects independently.

- Problem-solving is your superpower, and you're all about the details.

- Knowledge in NoSQL databases, such as DynamoDB and Elasticsearch.

- You're an awesome communicator and a great team player.

- Fast-paced environments? No problem for you.

- You're a nerd (in a good way) when it comes to staying on top of industry trends and best practices.

 Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component. 

 At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

 The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.

 The typical starting salary range for this role is:
 €67.000 — €106.000 EUR 

 Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People 

 As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

 We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

- Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary

- Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

- Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles

- Generous number of vacation days each year

- Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Advanced Threat Protection
jobs.jd:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 The Role 

 We seek a knowledgeable and research-focused Security Engineer to join a new Advanced Threat Protection team within Auth0 Customer Identity. This role does two things at once: it researches how attackers will use AI against identity systems, and it researches and builds how we use AI to defend our products, our infrastructure, and — most importantly — our customers' tenants.

 This role is a key member of the Security team embedded within the Customer Identity product unit and works across multiple functions to get ahead of emerging AI threats, supporting the growth of our global Customer Identity business.

 We are an engineering-focused team that seeks to stay on the cutting edge of security technology and the threat landscape. In this role you won't just assess our current AI security offering — you'll research what we should be protecting customers from one to two years ahead, turn that research into concrete protections, and help put AI-assisted defenses into the hands of the teams and customers who protect their tenants.

 In this role you will work as part of a globally distributed team of talented engineers who share a passion for security and enjoy solving complex problems at scale. This role works closely with and alongside the members of the broader Okta Security team in support of Okta's company-wide security strategy and Okta’s Secure Identity Commitment .

 This is a level-agnostic description; scope, autonomy, and leadership expectations scale with level (Senior through Staff).

 Responsibilities: 

- Research and lead how we can use AI to protect customer tenants — both proactively (hardening posture before an attack) and during active incidents (accelerating detection, triage, and response) 

- Research and build protections against novel AI attacks that Auth0 and Auth0's customers can be subjected to — adversarial ML, prompt injection, abuse of agentic protocols (MCP, A2A, UCP, and emerging equivalents), model and data poisoning — as they apply to identity systems and customer tenants

- Partner with the identity security teams to help customers strengthen their own tenant security posture through AI-assisted defenses 

- Research the emerging AI threat landscape and translate it into a forward-looking (12–24 month) view of what we need to protect ourselves and our customers from — then architect, recommend, and build the tooling to get there 

- Review and harden Auth0's AI security offering, identifying gaps and recommending mitigations before they're exploited 

- Partner across a globally distributed product-aligned team of security engineers to turn research into shipped protections for customer tenants 

- Establish a deep understanding of Okta Customer Identity products and infrastructure 

- Build, deploy & maintain scalable security solutions and automation that operationalize AI threat defenses at scale 

- Help meet our operational security commitments by thinking like an attacker, assessing the risk, and advising on mitigation strategies 

- Collaborate with the Okta Security team on security operations and, where relevant, support investigations and root cause analysis

 What this position is not: 

- Dedicated application security, code review, or compliance-focused work 

- Reactive patch and vulnerability management as a primary function — this role is about getting ahead of threats, not chasing them

 Requirements: 

- You have hands-on experience with AI/ML security — attacking, defending, or both (e.g., adversarial ML, LLM/prompt-injection attacks, agentic-system or model abuse), and an interest in using AI to build defenses, not just to study attacks 

- You have 4+ years of experience in security engineering, with a strong foundation in cloud infrastructure and/or product security 

- You have hands-on development experience — Go preferred — sufficient to prototype tooling, build AI-powered defenses, and operationalize your research 

- You have working knowledge and hands-on experience with one or more of the following: 

- AWS and/or Azure security 

- Kubernetes 

- You have strong knowledge of OWASP (including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) and secure coding best practices 

- You have a strong foundation in secure software development lifecycle best practices 

- You have strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn research into clear guidance for engineering and product teams 

- You have experience working with a globally distributed and remote team

 Bonus points if: 

- You have published threat research, CVEs, or conference talks in AI/ML security or identity security 

- You have built AI/ML-powered security tooling or defensive automation in a production environment 

- You have working knowledge and experience with one or more of the following: 

- Adversarial ML, model red-teaming, or AI safety research 

- The AI agent / MCP ecosystem and its security implications 

- Identity and access management 

- Full-stack engineering 

- Site reliability engineering 

- Vulnerability and threat management 

- Governance, risk and compliance

jobs.title: Principal Platform Software Engineer
jobs.location: Seattle, WA, United States | Santa Clara, CA, United States | Redwood City, CA, United States | Pleasanton, CA, United States
jobs.jd:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is building a team focused on advancing AI-native software development and delivering innovative cloud-based solutions. We are seeking experienced software engineers who combine strong programming fundamentals with hands-on experience leveraging AI-powered tools and agents to accelerate and improve the software development lifecycle.

 As a Principal Platform Software Engineer, you will translate business and technical requirements into detailed specifications, leverage LLMs and AI-assisted development tools to generate and refine code, and drive solutions from design through deployment and ongoing operations. You will work with modern cloud technologies and AI-enabled development workflows to build scalable, reliable, and maintainable software.

 The ideal candidate brings deep software engineering expertise, strong Java development skills, and practical experience integrating AI tools into everyday engineering workflows. This role focuses on applying AI to software engineering rather than developing or training AI models.

- Design, develop, deploy, and maintain scalable, cloud-based software applications and services.

- Translate business and technical requirements into detailed specifications and actionable development plans.

- Leverage AI-powered coding tools, LLMs, and AI agents to generate, refine, test, and maintain software.

- Apply AI-assisted code review, testing, debugging, and validation practices to ensure code quality, security, and reliability.

- Drive end-to-end software development, from requirements and architecture through implementation, deployment, and ongoing optimization.

- Develop and enhance Java-based applications and services using modern cloud development practices.

- Integrate AI-native development workflows and automation to improve engineering productivity, efficiency, and software delivery.

- Collaborate with engineering, product, and cross-functional teams to solve complex technical challenges and deliver high-quality solutions.

- Evaluate emerging AI developer tools and technologies, identifying opportunities to improve software development processes and engineering outcomes.
 Basic Qualifications 
 
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 8+ years of experience in software engineering, platform development, or related technical disciplines, with hands-on experience developing and delivering production software.

- Strong proficiency in Java and a solid understanding of software design, development, testing, and debugging.

- Experience developing applications or services using cloud technologies and cloud-based development environments.

- Hands-on experience using AI-assisted coding tools, LLMs, or AI agents as part of the software development lifecycle.

- Experience translating business or technical requirements into software specifications and working solutions.

- Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including code quality, testing, security, and maintainability.

- Experience with software deployment, troubleshooting, and ongoing application maintenance.

- Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
- Experience with AI-native development workflows, agentic coding tools, or LLM-powered developer platforms.

- Experience using AI tools across multiple stages of software development, including code generation, review, testing, deployment, and maintenance.

- Experience building and operating distributed applications or microservices in cloud environments.

- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and development automation.

- Experience evaluating or implementing AI-assisted engineering practices to improve developer productivity and software delivery.

- Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer- II
jobs.jd:
About us
 
Build the future of banking.
 
Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences. Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of $2 billion in 2025.
 
Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including:
 
1. Tachyon, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems
2. Cipher, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments

Xero’s ledger is the source of truth for millions of businesses, and every product we ship is built on top of it. As Lead Engineer, you will make the architectural decisions that set the course for the platform and the team, and you will see those decisions reach every customer who depends on Xero to get their numbers right.

 




THE TECHNICAL CHALLENGES

 - Correctness at scale. Accounting data has to be consistent, auditable, and immutable. There is no “close enough,” and every change to the ledger has to preserve that guarantee across regions and regulations.

 - Evolving a mature system. We are adding real-time expectations to a platform that millions of businesses depend on daily. That means strengthening service boundaries and clarifying data contracts without compromising reliability.

 - Durable, high-throughput services. We use durable execution (for example, Temporal) to keep long-running financial workflows accurate and recoverable under load.

 - AI-ready data. We are structuring accounting data so it can power AI-native experiences while maintaining trust in the numbers.




IMPACT

 - First six months: You understand the ledger and its consumers, align the team on service boundaries and data contracts, and ship a first modernization increment with no loss of data integrity.

You will own the technical direction for your area of the accounting platform, from design through production and on-call. You will make architectural decisions on service boundaries, data contracts, and technology choices without needing sign-off, and you will be accountable for reliability and data integrity end to end. - Apply strong applied-cryptography and PKI practices (X.509 certs, key rotation, TLS) to keep the auth path secure by default, not as an afterthought.

- Build and maintain reverse-proxy/HTTP-layer components (TLS termination, header handling) that front customer authentication traffic.

- Debug and resolve customer-facing identity/access issues, working with support to triage escalations quickly.

- Contribute to build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI) as needed.

- Maintain a small Windows companion application written in C#/.NET.

- Write and enhance end-to-end tests covering auth flows, failure modes, and edge cases (clock skew, revoked tokens, malformed assertions, etc.).

- Document known issues, workarounds, and design decisions in the team knowledge base as the team and product mature.

- Communicate clearly with product and engineering stakeholders on design tradeoffs, security posture, and escalation status.

 Must-have 

- Minimum experience of at least 8 Years

- Deep, practical knowledge of identity protocols: OIDC/OAuth 2.0 and SAML 2.0 — including token/assertion internals, standard flows, and failure modes.

- Working knowledge of Active Directory .

- Applied cryptography/PKI experience: X.509, JWT/JWKS, key rotation, TLS .

- Strong security engineering discipline — comfortable reasoning about threat models and building software to protect mission-critical systems, not just make features work.

- Solid understanding of OS fundamentals, networking, and concurrency.

- Working knowledge of Linux; comfortable writing shell/bash scripts.

- Simple, effective written and verbal communication.

 Nice-to-have 

- Directory internals (schema, bind operations).

- HTTP internals and reverse proxying (TLS, header injection).

The Network Region Build (NRB) team is responsible for deploying greenfield infrastructure, establishing network connectivity for new (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) OCI regions, and enabling compute connectivity for child sites. This includes building and managing data center fabrics, edge networks, backbone, fiber metro networks, and supporting multi-cloud initiatives. 

 NRB provides 24x7 operational support during build phases and oversees network and server rack adds, decommissions, and capacity expansions. The team also drives automation, process improvements, and tool development in collaboration with Network Automation to enhance efficiency. 

 This role involves designing, deploying, and operating large-scale global cloud networks. It requires a deep understanding of network protocols and programming skills to support automation at scale. As OCI's cloud network spans a global footprint, this role supports a vast infrastructure of network devices and millions of connected servers across dedicated backbone and internet-based connectivity. 

 Work locations:

 Seattle, WA

 Reston, VA

 Austin, TX

 Santa Clara

 Redwood City

 Nashville, TN

Participate in network lifecycle management through build and upgrade projects. Collaborate with program and project managers to define milestones and deliverables. Execute network changes using existing procedures and tools, and develop new procedures as needed. Serve as a technical lead on team projects, contributing to roadmap development, creating new runbooks and methods of procedure, and mentoring junior engineers. 
 
 Responsibilities include participating in solution and architecture design, developing standalone features, supporting operational rotations, providing break-fix support, serving as an escalation point, and leading post-event root cause analysis. Additional duties include coordinating with automation services to develop and integrate tooling, scripting to automate routine tasks, and acting as an SME for network automation projects. The role also involves collaborating with vendors to resolve software bugs, qualifying new firmware/operating systems, and driving product roadmap influence. 
 
 Critical Focus Areas 
 
- Cable, trunk, and optics troubleshooting, including structured cabling systems. 

- Break-fix and escalation support for complex network events. 

- Root cause analysis and remediation leadership. 

 Qualifications 
 
- Experience in large ISP or cloud provider environments. 

- Hands-on exposure to commodity Ethernet hardware (Broadcom, Mellanox). 

- Deep knowledge of routing and transport protocols: BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, TCP, IPv4, IPv6, DNS, DHCP, MPLS. 

- Experience with Internet peering, inter-domain networking, and VPN/SSL technologies. 

- Proficiency in scripting/automation (Python preferred) and datacenter design. 

- Familiarity with automation frameworks, network modeling (YANG, OpenConfig, NETCONF), and telemetry systems. 

- Strong understanding of network security design, system performance testing, and operational monitoring. 

- Excellent communication skills with proven ability to influence product direction and priorities.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Database Focus)
jobs.jd:
About us 

 GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless. 

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

 Platform Engineering at GoCardless 

 The Platform Engineering team is a unified, globally distributed team, currently located in London, Riga and Lisbon. We work with all other engineering teams to empower them to build, release, run and scale their products, with a strong focus on both strategic project delivery and operational excellence.

 Our work is a balance of: 

- Project delivery: building new platform components, from initial design to deployment.

- Operational support: keeping our systems healthy and stable through on-call rotations and incident management.

- Business as usual: continuous maintenance, improvements, and support for audits and compliance.

 The role 

 We’re looking for a Senior SRE with deep PostgreSQL expertise to own the reliability, performance and scalability of our database estate. Our databases sit at the heart of a payments platform, so slowdowns and outages directly affect our customers.

 You’ll work across our self-managed Stolon clusters and our GCP Cloud SQL fleet. Joining Mollie gives us the opportunity to consolidate, modularise and rethink how we run production databases, and you’ll help us do that while keeping everything reliable.

 What excites you 

- Run our database fleet reliably. Keep our production databases healthy and stable through significant change, including moves between platforms.

- Own performance and capacity. Right-size instances, tune connection limits and pooling (PgBouncer), memory and autovacuum settings, and fix slow queries, N+1s and unused indexes before customers feel them.

- Own upgrades and change. Lead major-version database upgrades end to end with minimal downtime, and own safe schema migrations, data migrations and backfills.

- Build in resilience. Reduce idle-in-transaction sessions, tighten statement timeouts, and design and test failover, replication and backup and recovery.

- Make it observable. Build dashboards and alerts in Grafana, Prometheus and Datadog to track saturation, latency and connection health.

- Partner with application teams. Help them use their databases well and improve their query patterns.

- Respond and learn. Take part in on-call, mitigate live database incidents, and run root cause analyses to prevent repeats.

 What excites us 

 Skills 

- Typically 5+ years of production experience running PostgreSQL, including high availability, replication, and backup and recovery

- Deep knowledge of Postgres performance and tuning: internals (memory settings, autovacuum, locking) and connection pooling, including managing it in production and supporting it on call

- Experience running production databases in the cloud, whether on managed services or self-managed on cloud infrastructure

- Strong query analysis skills (EXPLAIN plans, indexing strategy)

- Experience running major-version upgrades safely with minimal downtime

- Experience managing infrastructure as code with Terraform or similar IaC tooling

- Experience with monitoring and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog or similar)

- Experience writing code/working in software engineering teams

- Experience with on-call and incident response

- Ability to influence application teams

 Nice to have 

- Experience with Stolon , or similar Postgres HA tooling

- Experience with managed cloud Postgres (GCP CloudSQL, AWS RDS etc.)

- Experience with Kubernetes, GKE and ArgoCD

- Experience migrating databases between platforms

- Experience with SLOs and error budgets

- Experience in payments or financial services

 Why it matters 

 We hope you’re enthusiastic about the infrastructure space and the impact your work can have on others. In this role:

- You’ll work on a core system with direct, measurable impact on the reliability of the payments.

- You’ll solve hard performance and reliability problems in systems that matter.

- You’ll shape our database approach at a pivotal moment, as joining Mollie opens up choices about how we structure our estate.

- You’ll have real influence on technical design and decisions, and the chance to raise the bar for those around you.

- You’ll work closely with application teams and build easy-to-understand, maintainable tools and automation.

 Tech stack and tools 

- PostgreSQL, Stolon, Cloud SQL, PgBouncer

- Python, Ruby, Golang

- Terraform, Atlantis

- GCP

- Kubernetes, GKE

- GitHub, ArgoCD

- Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog

 We use a wide range of technologies and will never expect you to have experience with all of them.

Atlas Agent Engine is a platform that runs AI agents as customer workloads in strongly isolated environments, on multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters across multiple cloud providers. The platform's SRE team owns the operational foundations: the Kubernetes fleet, networking, observability and alerting, and tenant isolation.

 As part of an expanding SRE team, you will play a key role in defining operational strategies for our runtime, enhancing runtime security, and supporting expansion across additional cloud platforms.

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

The ideal candidate should:

- Have 6+ years of experience working on software development and operating distributed systems

- Proficiency in Go, or a similar language

- Have operated Kubernetes in production and be comfortable debugging it below the abstraction: scheduling, cluster networking, and node-level issues

- Understanding of Linux operating system internals and networking concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, routing)

- Expertise in cloud infrastructure platforms, including AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Azure

- Value efficiency in processes and operations

- Possess a customer-focused mindset

Responsibilities

- Operate and improve the multi-tenant Kubernetes infrastructure that runs customer workloads

- Build for reliability, making services and infrastructure available, resilient, fault-tolerant, and self-healing

- Identify and configure key metrics to detect incidents and quantify service health, availability, and performance

- Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to resolve issues involving the platform infrastructure

Strong candidates may also have experience with

- Kubernetes networking (e.g., Istio, Cilium) and service mesh or edge load balancing in production

- Designing secure, multi-tenant runtime environments at scale

- Managing and scaling infrastructure across multi-cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

- Virtualization and workload isolation technologies

About MongoDB

 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. About Team 
 Flow by ServiceNow is a standalone conversational AI service desk, with its own product and its own codebase. Employees ask for help wherever they already work — Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, or the browser. Flow answers from connected knowledge, handles the request, and runs automations the team publishes. AI is how the product works, and a person stays in control when the action is sensitive. 
 Flow is a new company inside ServiceNow, reimagining every function from first principles. We hire builders with agency and curiosity who use AI as the default way to design, review, and operate. They challenge inherited ways of working and treat their work as craft. 
 Flow is only as good as the systems it can read and the actions it can take. On the Integrations team, you’ll own how Flow connects to the systems companies run on, including identity, devices, ticketing, documents, and chat. You’ll turn them into three things: assets Flow can inventory, knowledge it can cite, and actions it can run. Every connection keeps each source’s permissions intact. 
 In your first 12 months, you’ll make sure priority systems support assets, automations, and knowledge that Flow can actually use. Connection health and failed actions will be operable without a specialist in the room, and every new system will follow one contract for permissions, audit, and proof. 
 Types of problems you’ll get to work on 
 
- Integration generation at scale. We don’t hand-write connectors. Build the pipeline that generates them from whatever a vendor publishes, which is often not a clean OpenAPI spec — and own spec normalization, pinned provenance, and deterministic regeneration across a growing catalog. 

- Tool surfaces an AI can actually call. An action’s name, description, schema, and examples are the product surface a model sees. Design them so the assistant picks the right action first try, scope them so they are safe for an AI to call, and measure whether it does. 

- Permissions and credentials you can prove. If a file is private to HR, a marketer must not see its title, its URL, or that it exists. Own access-model mirroring and delete detection, and pick the smallest credential policy each provider needs across validation, reconnect, revocation, and tenant isolation. 

- AI-native development itself. Agentic coding is how this team ships, not a productivity add-on. Author the skills and guardrails that let agents do integration work correctly, keep the deterministic provider-fake harness that makes fast iteration possible, and review generated code critically before anything ships. 

- Engineering leadership. Raise the technical bar through architecture decisions, code review, and coaching. Partner with product and design to shape requirements and explain tradeoffs clearly. 

 Our stack 
 TypeScript on Bun, PostgreSQL, Temporal for durable execution, Nango as the OAuth broker. We expect you to be excellent in a comparable stack and fluent in ours within weeks. We are not screening for this list.

To be successful in this role you have: 
 
- Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This includes current, hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development. 

- 8+ years of software engineering with strong fundamentals in system design, API design, relational data modeling, and testing. 

- Hands-on depth building and operating third-party integrations that real tenants depended on — webhooks, rate limits, pagination, incremental sync, delete detection. 

- Experience designing API or SDK surfaces that another system consumes correctly without a human reading the documentation — and interest in doing that for a model. 

- Ownership of a versioned contract where a rename breaks a customer: stable identifiers, deprecation, and migration. 

- Sound judgment about least-privilege access — scope minimization per action, admin consent, secrets handling, tenant isolation — and about which actions an AI may take on its own. 

- Comfort with ambiguity and the drive to build from 0–1 without a playbook. 

- A record of technical leadership: architecture ownership, code-quality bar-raising, and mentoring engineers. 

 Nice to have 
 
- Experience evaluating tool or function selection — measuring whether a model picks the right action. 

- Experience with RAG or the Model Context Protocol (MCP). 

- Familiarity with SCIM or directory sync. 

- Background in IT service management or employee support products. 

 Why join us 
 Intelligence is commoditizing. Connection and execution are not. A model that reasons brilliantly and cannot act on the systems a company actually runs is a demo. 
 Flow already reaches a broad and growing share of the systems enterprises run day to day, and this team decides how fast that surface grows and how far each connection can be trusted. We aren’t writing connectors one at a time. We’re building the generator, the contract every provider follows, and the proof that what Flow says it did, it actually did. Real problems: a vendor specification that lies, an access model that must be mirrored exactly or not at all, a sync that resumes cleanly a million items later, and a tool surface a model has to get right without reading the documentation.

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

 We are looking for a Senior Manager, Developer Solutions who is passionate about building partnerships in the games industry that accelerate adoption of Discord’s engagement and monetization solutions (social layer SDK, Nitro Rewards, Social Commerce, Collectibles). You will build partnership and sales strategies, as well as lead deal execution, including sourcing and negotiating complex, high-impact partnerships. You will interact with senior executives at our partner organizations and be a trusted evangelist for Discord’s products and priorities. Internally, you will be an advocate for our partners and bring the “voice of the developer” to inform business and product decisions. This is a senior-level individual contributor role and will report into the VP of Developer Solutions.

 What you'll be doing 

- Identify high-fit games and developers for Discord’s Social SDK, commerce, and analytics offerings

- Own a territory / book of business of AAA and AA game developers with quarterly goals tied to your performance

- Own the sales / deal process from prospecting, qualification, decision, terms negotiation to deal close

- Understand developer needs in regard to monetization, user growth, and social mechanics. This includes identifying the optimal path and selection for third party technology adoption 

- Be a subject matter expert on the team around deal construction for player rewards in gaming, especially when tied to subscription products and monetization 

- Build and manage a healthy, predictable pipeline through outbound prospecting, targeted outreach, and strategic account mapping. Fully document your progress using CRM tools

- Lead strategy, structuring, and negotiation of key partnership agreements, including developing clear commercial frameworks and defining technical scope.

- Align GTM and execution with leaders across Product, Engineering, Ad Sales, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Legal and Executive Leadership; remove roadblocks and ensure partner success and achieve defined KPIs.

- Work alongside Customer Success to identify upsell / cross-sell opportunities and deepen relationships within existing customers.

 What you should have 

- 5-7+ years of proven experience in business development, sales and partnerships experience

- 3+ years of experience in structuring and closing high impact deals in the player rewards and consumer subscriptions categories

- Experience in enterprise SaaS / SDK adoption, game developer tools, analytics / insights sales or related roles at software or platform companies is a plus

- Strong track record of winning new logos and closing complex deals with enterprise customers

- Proven track record sourcing, negotiating, and scaling complex partnerships with measurable impact on revenue, adoption, and monetization 

- Proven ability to work with internal cross-functional teams at early stages to define and articulate partner value within the context of Discord

- Deep knowledge and experience in the gaming space, specifically 

- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional execution with clear ownership and accountability 

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience producing clear, executive-ready materials (e.g., strategy memos, deal summaries, business cases, and partner communications)

 Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties) or New York Metropolitan Area. Relocation assistance may be available. 
 This position is commission-based and is eligible for variable incentive. The On Target Earnings (OTE) range for this full-time position is listed below. This position will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) plan; life and disability insurance; paid vacation, sick time, and holidays; and paid parental, medical, and caregiver leave. Our ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in role postings reflect the On Target Earnings only, and do not include equity, or benefits. Applications for this role are accepted on an ongoing basis. 

 On Target Earnings
 $232,000 — $261,000 USD 

 Why Discord? 

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away! 

 Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.jd:
Who we are 

 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

 About the role: 

 As a Senior Software Engineer on Safety Core, you’ll build software that helps customers identify and reduce risk across vehicles, equipment, workers, and customer sites. You’ll develop the systems and product capabilities that turn signals from connected devices and operational workflows into timely, trustworthy safety insights. Initial opportunities may support Safety Operated Equipment or Safety Installations, with the flexibility to contribute to other Safety Core initiatives as priorities evolve. You’ll take ambiguous customer and operational problems from discovery through technical design, production delivery, and measurement. This role is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys defining both the problem and the approach, making sound trade-offs, and connecting engineering work to customer outcomes.

 This is a position open to candidates based in or close to Toronto, Canada. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

 You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

- You want to build for scale: With over 2.3 million IoT devices deployed to our global customers, you will work on a range of new and mature technologies driving scalable innovation for customers across industries driving the world's physical operations.

- You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.

- You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.

- You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win – together.

 In this role, you will: 

- Unlock new customer-facing Safety product capabilities, not just maintain existing systems. Pursue the best solution to the problem - even when that means working beyond a single service or discipline and partnering across application, platform, data, and ML.

- Translate customer and operational needs into useful, maintainable capabilities, initially supporting Safety Operated Equipment or Safety Installations, with the flexibility to contribute to other Safety Core priorities.

- Own outcomes, not just project delivery: start from the real-world safety or customer problem, help define how success will be measured, and stay accountable for whether the product meaningfully improves that measure. Frame ambiguous problems, identify what is needed, align partners, deliver, measure impact in production, and iterate until the intended outcome is achieved. Be resourceful and move quickly while maintaining sound engineering judgment.

- Build and operate reliable software across the parts of the stack needed to deliver the outcome, making pragmatic trade-offs across customer value, reliability, scalability, delivery speed, and long-term maintainability.

- Use AI tools as a core part of the engineering workflow to accelerate discovery, design, implementation, testing, debugging, and iteration; validate outputs and remain accountable for the quality of what ships.

- Partner closely across functions - including product, design, platform, data, and ML—to turn customer needs and real-world feedback into clear technical plans and shipped improvements.

- Use production data, customer feedback, and operational signals to understand whether the real-world problem is improving - not just whether the engineering solution shipped—and use that evidence to guide iteration.

- Raise the engineering bar through strong technical designs, thoughtful reviews, clear communication, mentoring, and improvements to how the team builds and operates software.

- Automatically included - do not run through Bias Decoder: 

- All Roles : Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

- People Manager Roles : Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

 Minimum requirements for the role: 

- 4+ years of professional software development experience.

- Experience shipping and supporting production software that solves customer problems.

- Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building production systems in at least one modern programmin

- Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.

- Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.

- Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.

- Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.

- Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.

- Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.

- Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.

- Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.
 
 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

 Join Barclays as a Senior Engineer - AI Platform role, where to design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.

 To be successful in this role, you should have below skills: 
 
- Platform/infra architecture at enterprise scale (5+ yrs) distributed systems, active-active, failover patterns

- Expert Python (FastAPI/async) or Go/Java — high-throughput, low-latency production systems

- Deep AWS/EKS/Envoy — Bedrock, IAM, Aurora, CloudFormation, GPU scheduling, multi-tenancy, service mesh (Istio), envoy

- GenAI/Agentic AI — LangGraph/LangChain or Google ADK, MCP/A2A protocols, prompt engineering, RAG, vLLM serving
 
 Some other highly valued skills may include below: 
 
- AI safety/guardrails — prompt injection detection, PII redaction, content filtering

- AI security frameworks — NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP LLM Top 10

- Envoy Proxy (xDS API, WASM filters, AI Gateway extensions)

- Financial services background — regulatory, data residency, compliance
 
 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

 This role is based in Bengaluru and Pune office.

jobs.jd:
AI Security Incubation & Innovation 
 Security and Risk Engineering 
 
 About the team 
 The Security and Risk Engineering organization builds scalable, AI-powered security solutions that reduce risk and protect ServiceNow and its customers. We value AI-first thinking, clean architecture, intuitive experiences, and a culture of continuous learning.
 This is a zero-to-one incubation. We’re building a new class of exposure analysis that ranks security work by exploitability—where an attacker could realistically get in—rather than raw severity. The architecture is evolving, and this role helps define what good looks like.
 The Role 
 As a Senior Software Engineer – AI Native Development, you will design, build, and operate next-generation AI-powered applications and platforms. You will combine strong full-stack software engineering fundamentals with hands-on expertise in modern AI/ML technologies to build production-grade experiences powered by LLMs, agents, retrieval, and intelligent automation.
 You will work across the technology stack—from user experiences and APIs to distributed services, data and retrieval systems, AI/ML workflows, and cloud infrastructure. You will be expected to use AI-native development practices to accelerate engineering productivity while maintaining high standards for scalability, reliability, security, and quality.
 This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex problems end-to-end and is excited about applying AI as a core engineering capability, not simply as an add-on to traditional software.
 What You'll Own

jobs.jd:
About the Team

The Agent Platform team at OpenAI builds the production systems that bring useful AI agents to users around the world. We provide the platform that enables agents to execute code, use tools, and interact with software reliably and securely at scale.

We work closely with product, research, and infrastructure teams to turn new agent capabilities into dependable product experiences. Our work spans the execution environments, APIs, and integrations that support agentic products such as Codex and tool use in ChatGPT.

We focus on how agents run in production: making it easy to launch new capabilities, supporting growing demand, and improving the performance and reliability of the systems behind user experiences.

Some of the hardest problems in making agents useful emerge when they meet real-world workloads. We build the platform that helps agents handle those workloads safely, recover when things go wrong, and deliver consistent results.



About the Role

As a Software Engineer on the Agent Platform team, you will build and scale the services that power agentic products at OpenAI. You’ll work closely with product engineers, researchers, and infrastructure engineers to bring new capabilities from early prototypes to production.

Your work will include designing APIs and services, improving agent execution and orchestration, and building the integrations needed to support increasingly capable agents. You’ll help launch new experiences while strengthening the reliability, observability, and efficiency of the platform underneath them.

We’re looking for engineers with experience building large-scale backend systems or infrastructure who enjoy working close to products and users. You should be comfortable moving quickly through ambiguous problems while making thoughtful decisions about security, performance, and long-term maintainability.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.



In this role, you will:

 - Build and operate production services that enable agents to execute code, use tools, and interact with external systems.

 - Design APIs and platform abstractions that make it easier for product teams to build and launch agentic experiences.

 - Develop orchestration systems that manage agent execution, state, resource allocation, retries, and recovery.

 - Improve platform reliability, latency, and efficiency through performance optimization, observability, and capacity planning.

 - Partner with product, research, security, and infrastructure teams to bring new agent capabilities into production.

 - Own systems through their full lifecycle, from design and implementation to rollout, monitoring, and ongoing operation.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have experience building and operating large-scale backend services, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure.

 - Enjoy building shared platforms and APIs that help other engineers move faster.

 - Can take an early prototype, turn it into a reliable service, and evolve it as usage grows.

 - Have a strong understanding of system performance, concurrency, failure modes, and resource management.

 - Care about how infrastructure decisions affect the user experience, including responsiveness, reliability, and predictable behavior.

 - Are comfortable working across service boundaries and collaborating with teams to solve problems from end to end.

 - Have experience with cloud platforms, containers, orchestration systems, or infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.

jobs.jd:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

 What is The Role 

 We are on the lookout for a Senior Platform Productivity Engineer to join our Elasticsearch team and focus on ensuring that the shared platform functionalities of Elasticsearch are easy to use, performant, maintainable and secure.

 The team’s mission is to create foundational infrastructure and shared functionality that enables engineers to develop, extend, and support Elasticsearch. The team owns common functionality such as services, settings and scripting, and makes Elasticsearch extensible through plugins or the Painless scripting language. The team also makes Elasticsearch observable by providing logging and telemetry information. We also own the orchestration of Elasticsearch in serverless, the CI/CD workflows and enable Elasticsearch developers to deliver Elasticsearch to customers - serverless, cloud and on-premise alike.
