- Contributing to large, impactful projects that evolve the core infrastructure that underpins Elasticsearch.

- Making Elasticsearch developers more productive by identifying and developing opportunities for automation, and integrating agentic apps into development workflows.

- Solving difficult issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.

- Improving operation and observability of Elasticsearch cloud systems.

- Collaborating in the open with the ES team, Elastic users, and other supporting open source projects.

- Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.

- Experience working with large (millions of code lines) code bases.

- Experience leading large scale projects across engineering teams.

- Willingness to dive into new issues and ask for help when you need it.

- You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points

- Experience working in a platform team or developer productivity team

- Experience with low-level Java such as concurrency, parallelism, classloaders, etc.

- Knowledge of JDK internals: modules, the Java memory model, garbage collection, database load, caching techniques, etc.

- Experience with observability and telemetry solutions, particularly OpenTelemetry

- Knowledge of Go

Business & Platform Overview 
 Citi is a global market maker and industry leader across all major Fixed Income markets. The Fixed Income Trade Processing (FITP) platform is Citi’s mission-critical global trade capture and risk management engine, processing 200,000+ transactions daily across Derivatives, Cash, Rates, Credit, and Exotic products for 2,000+ Front Office, Sales, and Middle Office users across 80+ countries supporting multiple businesses – Rates, Global Spread products, Markets Treasury and Finance Desk.
 The platform interfaces with 60+ electronic trading venues and 20+ global regulatory bodies, providing real-time trade capture, low-latency risk and compliance feeds, and automated settlement orchestration.

 Role Summary 
 We are seeking an exceptional, hands-on Lead Platform Architect & Engineer to spearhead the technical vision, architecture, and engineering execution for our next-generation, low-latency Fixed Income trade processing platform.
 In this role, you will lead the strategic transformation of our core trading systems, driving microservices modernization, AI-assisted engineering adoption, and continuous cyber/vulnerability automation. You will balance hands-on Java engineering with senior technical leadership, collaborating directly with Trading desks, Quants, Product Managers, and global engineering teams across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Architecture, Modernization & Hands-On Engineering 
 
- Core Java Engineering: Write high-performance, low-latency, mission-critical Java code, setting gold standards for concurrency, memory optimization, and clean design patterns.

- Microservices Transformation: Lead the strategic re-architecture from monolithic components to scalable, event-driven, containerized microservices across cloud and on-prem environments.

- Low-Latency & Real-Time Feeds: Architect end-to-end data pipelines for low latency trade consumption, position keeping, and real-time distribution to downstream Risk, Compliance, MIS, and Clearing/Settlement systems.
 2. Innovation, AI Adoption & Vulnerability Automation 
 
- AI-Assisted Engineering: Drive the active adoption of GenAI and developer-assist tooling across the engineering lifecycle to accelerate time-to-market, test generation, and code quality.

- Automated Cyber & Vulnerability Defense: Embed automated security scanning, dependency patching, and vulnerability management into CI/CD pipelines to proactively safeguard the platform against cyber threats.

- DevOps & Release Velocity: Champion automated quality gates, BDD/TDD practices, and zero-touch release automation (Release on Demand).

- Front-Office Business Partnership: Face off directly with Traders, Desk Heads, Quants, Middle Office, and Compliance leads translating complex trading needs into resilient technical solutions.

- Global Team Leadership: Mentor, coach, and elevate global engineering squads across Canada, NY, the UK, and Asia, fostering an engineering culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning.

- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related STEM discipline.

- Core Computer Science Foundations: Deep expertise in low-latency Java, multithreading/concurrency models, data structures, JVM tuning, distributed messaging (Kafka/MQ), and design patterns.

- Architecture & Modernization: Proven track record of executing enterprise microservice transformations and event-driven architecture rollouts.

- DevSecOps & Security: Hands-on experience integrating automated vulnerability management, secret management (Vault/COIN), CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks (TDD/BDD).

- Collaborative & Global Perspective: Thrives in a highly matrixed, diverse, global engineering organization.

- Continuous Learner: Proactively adopts emerging technologies (AI/ML developer tools, modern cloud/container platforms) to maintain competitive advantage.

jobs.jd:
Why join us 

 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

 Engineering at Brex 

 Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration, own outcomes end to end, and push for excellence from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft and builders grow by solving meaningful technical problems.

 What you’ll do 

 As a Senior GRC Engineer at Brex, you’ll lead the IT security compliance workstreams that connect our technical control owners to the people who examine our controls: external auditors, Internal Audit, state regulators, and Finance. You’ll coordinate and test the technical controls behind our financial reporting (SOX/ITGC), our annual SOC 1 Type 2 report, our state money transmitter examinations, and our FINRA IT requirements. You’ll also run the annual business continuity and disaster recovery (BC/DR) testing calendar.

 As part of the GRC team you may also contribute to the following operational tasks:

- Third party risk management 

- Risk register maintenance and reporting

- Customer Trust / GTM due diligence support

- Tooling access requests

- Assist with requests related to other certifications like SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, or ISO 27001

 Where you’ll work 

 This role will be based in our New York City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

 Responsibilities 

- Lead IT SOX/ITGC test procedures, walkthroughs, evidence, workpapers, and remediation across logical access, change management, computer operations, and IT governance.

- Manage our annual SOC 1 Type 2 engagement, including external auditor coordination, control descriptions, evidence, deficiency tracking, and review of draft report sections.

- Support state money transmitter (MTL) examinations by working with Legal, Compliance, and Finance on IT documentation, examiner requests, and tracking of IT findings.

- Test quarterly user access reviews, privileged-access evidence, and segregation-of-duties remediation, and verify that in-scope changes are complete and properly authorized.

- Run the annual BC/DR testing calendar, including tabletop and failover exercises, and document results, evidence, and remediation.

- Prepare FINRA-related IT control documentation, including business continuity, books-and-records, systems access reviews, and readiness testing.

- Track findings through to closure with clear control owners, deadlines, and evidence, and keep audit coordination separate from control operation.

- Support broader GRC team operational tasks related to evidence collection, access requests, and risk management.

 Requirements 

- 5+ years of experience in IT audit, SOX/ITGC testing, GRC, or technology compliance, in fintech, financial services, or public accounting.

- Hands-on experience with ITGC testing across logical access, change management, and computer operations, and with documenting results in audit workpapers.

- Working knowledge of SOC 1 / SSAE 18, including Type 2 reports, control descriptions, and deficiency management.

- Familiarity with PCAOB standards.

- Experience working with external auditors, regulators, or examiners and responding to their requests on deadline.

- Strong organization and project management skills, with the ability to run several audit workstreams on different calendars at once.

- Clear communication, and comfort holding technical control owners accountable for evidence and remediation.

 Bonus points 

- CISA, CIA, CPA, or CISSP certification.

- Experience with state money transmitter examinations or FINRA IT and books-and-records requirements.

- Experience coordinating BC/DR testing, including tabletop and failover exercises.

- Experience supporting audit readiness during an acquisition or integration.

- Familiarity with COSO 2013 and COBIT.

- Experience with GRC or audit workflow tools, or with SQL or scripting for control testing.

 Compensation 

 The expected salary range for this role is $173,568 - $238,656 . However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

 Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.
 Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

Why join us 

 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

 Engineering at Brex 

 Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration, own outcomes end to end, and push for excellence from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft and builders grow by solving meaningful technical problems.

 What you’ll do 

 As a Senior GRC Engineer at Brex, you’ll lead the IT security compliance workstreams that connect our technical control owners to the people who examine our controls: external auditors, Internal Audit, state regulators, and Finance. You’ll coordinate and test the technical controls behind our financial reporting (SOX/ITGC), our annual SOC 1 Type 2 report, our state money transmitter examinations, and our FINRA IT requirements. You’ll also run the annual business continuity and disaster recovery (BC/DR) testing calendar.

 As part of the GRC team you may also contribute to the following operational tasks:

- Third party risk management 

- Risk register maintenance and reporting

- Customer Trust / GTM due diligence support

- Tooling access requests

- Assist with requests related to other certifications like SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, or ISO 27001

 Where you’ll work 

 This role will be based in our San Francisco office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

 Responsibilities 

- Lead IT SOX/ITGC test procedures, walkthroughs, evidence, workpapers, and remediation across logical access, change management, computer operations, and IT governance.

- Manage our annual SOC 1 Type 2 engagement, including external auditor coordination, control descriptions, evidence, deficiency tracking, and review of draft report sections.

- Support state money transmitter (MTL) examinations by working with Legal, Compliance, and Finance on IT documentation, examiner requests, and tracking of IT findings.

- Test quarterly user access reviews, privileged-access evidence, and segregation-of-duties remediation, and verify that in-scope changes are complete and properly authorized.

- Run the annual BC/DR testing calendar, including tabletop and failover exercises, and document results, evidence, and remediation.

- Prepare FINRA-related IT control documentation, including business continuity, books-and-records, systems access reviews, and readiness testing.

- Track findings through to closure with clear control owners, deadlines, and evidence, and keep audit coordination separate from control operation.

- Support broader GRC team operational tasks related to evidence collection, access requests, and risk management.

 Requirements 

- 5+ years of experience in IT audit, SOX/ITGC testing, GRC, or technology compliance, in fintech, financial services, or public accounting.

- Hands-on experience with ITGC testing across logical access, change management, and computer operations, and with documenting results in audit workpapers.

- Working knowledge of SOC 1 / SSAE 18, including Type 2 reports, control descriptions, and deficiency management.

- Familiarity with PCAOB standards.

- Experience working with external auditors, regulators, or examiners and responding to their requests on deadline.

- Strong organization and project management skills, with the ability to run several audit workstreams on different calendars at once.

- Clear communication, and comfort holding technical control owners accountable for evidence and remediation.

 Bonus points 

- CISA, CIA, CPA, or CISSP certification.

- Experience with state money transmitter examinations or FINRA IT and books-and-records requirements.

- Experience coordinating BC/DR testing, including tabletop and failover exercises.

- Experience supporting audit readiness during an acquisition or integration.

- Familiarity with COSO 2013 and COBIT.

- Experience with GRC or audit workflow tools, or with SQL or scripting for control testing.

 Compensation 

 The expected salary range for this role is $173,568 - $238,656. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

 Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.
 Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Brex recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with a brex.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Brex via other sources should be ignored.

Job Description: 
 Job Title: Senior Engineer 
 Location: Pune, India 
 Corporate Title: AVP 
 
 Role Description 
 As a Senior Engineer in the Channel Security team, you will be a core individual contributor responsible for the hands-on development of our mission-critical platform. You will focus on writing high-quality, scalable code for the backend services that power our real-time channel security capabilities. You will work closely with the Lead Engineer to build, test, and deploy a resilient and performant system
 
 Overview: 
 
- Corporate Banking is a technology centric business, with an increasing move to real-time processing, an increasing appetite from customers for integrated systems and access to supporting data. This means that technology is more important than ever for business.

- Deutsche Bank is one of the few banks with the scale and network to compete aggressively in this space, and the breadth of investment in this area is unmatched by our peers. Joining the team is a unique opportunity to help rebuild the core of some of our most mission critical processing systems from the ground-up.

- Our Corporate Bank Technology team is a global team across 30 countries. The primary businesses that we support within Corporate Bank are Cash Management, Securities Services, Trade Finance and Trust & Agency Services. CB Technology supports these businesses through ‘vertical’ CIO aligned teams and by ‘horizontals’ such as Client Connectivity, Surveillance and Regulatory, Infrastructure, Architecture, Production, and Risk & Control.
 
 What we’ll offer you 
 As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
 
- Best in class leave policy

- Gender neutral parental leaves

- 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)

- Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education

- Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members

- Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents

- Accident and Term life Insurance

- Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above
 
 Your key responsibilities 
 
- Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality, scalable backend microservices for the Channel Security platform using Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and related technologies.

- Partner with the Lead Engineer on solution design and participate actively in code reviews to ensure alignment with architectural principles and maintain high code quality standards.

- Implement robust integrations with internal and external systems.

- Champion a "shift-left" approach to quality by writing comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for all new features.

- Contribute to the operational health of the platform by participating in troubleshooting, and incident resolution as part of our "you build it, you run it" culture.

- Collaborate with the DevOps engineer to ensure services are observable, easy to deploy, and meet non-functional requirements for performance and reliability.
 
 Your skills and experience 

- Strong, hands-on backend programming experience with the modern Java ecosystem (Java 17+, Spring Boot).

- Overall experience of 9-14 years in software engineering, with a strong focus on building robust, scalable banking systems.

- Hands-on Experience using AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, or experimenting with LLMs/AI APIs to improve engineering productivity, testing, troubleshooting, or automation

- 

- Solid understanding of microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and distributed systems principles.

- Practical experience with event-driven architecture and messaging systems, specifically Kafka.

- Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and an understanding of in-memory data stores/caches (Redis).

- A strong commitment to quality with hands-on experience in writing various levels of automated tests (unit, integration, E2E, BDD).

- Experience working in a cloud-native environment (GCP preferred) and familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and agile development methodologies.

- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex issues across multiple services.

- A collaborative mindset with strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a lean, focused engineering team.
 
 Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs. 
 
 How we’ll support you 
 
- Training and development to help you excel in your career

- Coaching and support from experts in your team

- A culture of continuous learning to aid progression

- A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
 
 About us and our teams 
 Please visit our company website for further information:
 https://www.db.com/company/company.html 

 We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
 Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
 
 We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

Working at Atlassian: 
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. 

The Role:
 We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer for the Internal Data Platform team, reporting to the team’s Senior Engineering Manager. This role suits candidates with experience building data platforms at scale and a passion for solving complex analytical problems with modern technologies.
 The successful candidate will have extensive experience in software development, distributed systems, cloud technologies and infrastructure, and ideally in data platforms. Data engineering skills are valuable, but this is primarily a software engineering role. 
 As part of our team, you will help develop and maintain solutions for Atlassian's data platform, focusing on reliability, scalability and performance. You will have the chance to build a petabyte-scale data lake using vendor, open-source and custom-built technologies. You will collaborate with a diverse team of backend engineers to serve stakeholders ranging from data engineers and data scientists to product managers and senior leadership.

- Design, develop and own the delivery of high-quality data platform and software services to support a petabyte-scale data lake.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, senior engineers and architects across multiple disciplines to discuss, design and ship new features.

- Help maintain high code quality through peer reviews and by defining and establishing coding standards, guidelines and best practices within the team.

- Drive improvements in operational excellence, including security, reliability, availability, performance, procedures and processes.

- Use a data-driven approach to inform decisions and design technical solutions.

- 5+ years of experience in a software engineering role, preferably in the data platform domain.

- A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related discipline.

- Expertise in solving complex distributed systems problems.

- Experience building applications in one or more of the following languages: Kotlin, Scala, Java or Python.

- Strong knowledge of AWS or GCP services.

- Familiarity with cloud architecture patterns and the engineering practices needed to build high-quality, performant, scalable, reliable and highly available software.

- Experience with data processing frameworks and technologies such as Spark, Flink, StarRocks, Databricks, dbt or Airflow.

 Benefits & Perks 
 Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits . 
 
 About Atlassian 
 At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
 We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
 To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
 To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh . 
 In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

Float is on a mission to simplify finance for Canadian businesses, empowering them to eliminate complexity and unlock new opportunities. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth. 

 

As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/rob-magazine/top-growing-companies/article-ranking-canadas-top-growing-companies-of-2024/ and top-rated startups in 2025 https://www.linkedin.com/posts/floatfinancial_were-proud-to-share-that-float-has-been-activity-7387093684720300032-2DDz/, 2024 https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linkedin-top-startups-2024-15-canadian-companies-rise-linkedin-news-llihe/ and 2023 https://lnkd.in/TSU23CA, Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple.

 

At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success.




OUR PRODUCT

Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 10,000 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C https://floatfinancial.com/press/float-financial-raises-cad-85-million-series-c, and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank.

 

Our team is a collection of ambitious, collaborative and mission-driven people from all walks of life but with one goal: helping Canadian companies not just survive but thrive. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada.




AI USE IN OUR HIRING PROCESS

We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Float is building an agent that works as a chief financial officer for every Canadian business: it knows the business, has all the context, and works around the clock. You would join the small team building the foundation for it, with a blank slate and a direct line to the product teams that will build on what you make.



You’ll have the best seat in the house on how to apply the frontier to real finance problems: taking raw model intelligence and turning it into durable, scalable, useful products. The team sits between the model providers, Float’s product teams, and the customers whose finances we run, building the harness —memory, skills, tools, evals, observability, distribution channels — that every agent at Float runs on.



This is a zero-to-one position. You will build the core pieces that let agents act reliably in production, and the interfaces and channels customers reach them through, then scale them across Float’s products. The field is moving quickly, so the best people here learn fast and are glad to rebuild something when a better approach arrives.



We are hiring across multiple levels for this role. Our interview process evaluates scope, judgment and learning velocity, and we level accordingly. At Staff, you set the patterns the harness is built on and the evaluation and observability bar every agent at Float meets. This role suits engineers who have shipped agents to real users, want more ownership than a large company can offer, and like to build.




WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Ship agents that save customers real money and time. Take them from the first prototype to production at scale, and own the outcome once they’re live.

 - Build the unified harness. Context management, capabilities and tool use, evaluation, monitoring and observability — the layer every agent at Float runs on and scales through.

 - Make agent actions safe to trust with a company’s money. Permissions, approvals, audit trails, and clear behaviour when the agent is uncertain or wrong.

 - Define what good looks like and measure it. Offline evals, production monitoring of agent decisions, and the loop that turns incidents into improvements.

 - Build the interfaces agents are delivered through. Chat, generative UI, and multiple channels at once.

 - Make product teams faster. Partner with them so they can launch their own agent capabilities on the harness without rebuilding it.

 - Stay on the frontier. Track models, inference and context management, and rework what we’ve built when a better approach appears.

 - Representative projects:
   
   - Build the approval and audit layer that lets an agent pay a bill on a customer’s behalf.

jobs.jd:
About Us

 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

 Available Locations: Atlanta, GA; Austin, TX; Denver, CO; New York City; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; Washington D.C.; Toronto, Canada

 About the role 

 Many of Cloudflare’s critical internal services run on Kubernetes. These services include those responsible for Cloudflare’s control plane and APIs, data analytics and other internal tools used to manage our global network. These Kubernetes platforms are purpose-built from the ground up and run on bare metal Linux in different regions around the world. The scale we work at involves tens of thousands of containers and terabits per second of network traffic. The team takes pride in knowing this platform helps run parts of the global Internet.

 As an engineer on the Kubernetes platform team, you'll be building the tools to help engineers deploy and operate the services that make Cloudflare work. Our mission is to provide a reliable and flexible platform to help product teams release new software efficiently and safely. The role includes both software engineering and DevOps operational responsibilities.

 Responsibilities 

- Design scalable and resilient systems that can keep up with company growth.

- Work with application teams to understand their needs and challenges, and help them choose the best way to architect their systems to run well in our Kubernetes environment.

- Harden the platform against security threats, noisy neighbours, and accidents.

- Improve the efficiency of our use of resources such as CPU, memory, bandwidth, and storage.

- Help respond to, resolve, and prevent incidents impacting the platform or our users.

- Contribute back to the open source community. Some of our favorite open source projects include: Envoy, Contour, Consul, etcd, cdk8s, Cloudprober, Calico, Ceph, Rook, KubeVirt, and more.

 Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience 

- Experience managing production Kubernetes clusters.

- Experience operating systems on-premise at scale in roles such as SRE, systems design or architecture.

- Excellent debugging skills in a Linux environment.

- Knowledge of how container runtimes work inside of Linux (isolation, storage, and networking).

- A firm grasp of IP networking including routing and iptables/nftables.

- Ability to work with codebases in Go, TypeScript, and Bash/shell.

- The ability to break down complex problems into smaller pieces, provide options, talk through trade-offs, build consensus, and drive the effort to solve the problem.

 Bonus Points 

- Familiarity with building platforms across multiple zones and regions as the foundation for other teams to build distributed highly-available applications.

- Experience with configuration management frameworks such as SaltStack or Ansible.

- Experience with continuous deployment tooling like ArgoCD and Argo Rollouts.

- Operational/administrator experience with etcd, Ceph, Rook, KubeVirt, CNIs, ClusterAPI, Envoy, and/or Contour.

- Experience as a user of Prometheus, Elasticsearch/Kibana, Vault, Redis, and/or Consul.

Compensation

 Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

- For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000

- For Denver based hires: Estimated annual salary of $168,000 - $231,000

- For New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000

- For Seattle based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000

- For Washington D.C. based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000

- For Toronto, Canada based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $206,000

Applications will be accepted until December 25, 2026.

Equity

 This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.

Benefits

 Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

 Health & Welfare Benefits

- Medical/Rx Insurance

- Dental Insurance

- Vision Insurance

- Flexible Spending Accounts

- Commuter Spending Accounts

- Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

- On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

- Global Travel Medical Insurance

 Financial Benefits

- Short and Long Term Disability Insurance

- Develop GPU-resident communication primitives and device-side APIs that enable fine-grained, kernel-initiated data movement across nodes and accelerators.

- Profile and tune GPU kernels end-to-end, identifying bottlenecks at the intersection of compute, memory, and network, and driving targeted optimizations.

- Collaborate with network software, hardware, and AI framework teams to co-design communication strategies that align with GPU execution patterns and emerging model architectures.

 What we need to see:

- Strong understanding of GPU architecture fundamentals: warp scheduling, shared memory, L2 cache, memory coalescing, occupancy tuning, and asynchronous execution.

 Ways to stand out from the crowd:

- Experience with overlap techniques such as kernel pipelining, persistent kernels, or cooperative groups to hide communication latency behind compute.

- Proven experience evaluating and optimizing large-scale LLM training or inference workloads, including hands-on work with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorRT-LLM, or vLLM, and familiarity with emerging serving architectures such as disaggregated serving.

Every team at Xero has work that is slow, manual and error-prone, and the people doing it are often the ones best placed to make better decisions if they had the time. We're building agentic AI workflows that take that toil away, so our people can focus on the work that matters.

The Internal AI accelerator squad partners directly with Xero's enterprise and G&A functions, including HR, Legal and Finance. As Lead Engineer, you'll set the technical direction for the squad as it builds agents and workflows that the business can run itself. You'll stay hands-on in the hardest problems, coach the Senior Engineers around you, and be the senior technical voice with executive leaders across the business.

The Technical Challenges

The squad is early in its life, and the problems are as much about judgement as engineering. Four problems define the work:

 - A repeatable way to build agents: Define the patterns, frameworks and standards the squad uses so each new workflow is faster to build and safer to run than the last.

 - Agents the business trusts: Build agentic workflows that handle real work, with human review, guardrails and clear escalation, so business teams are comfortable relying on them.

 - Production, not prototypes: Set the bar for evals, observability and cost control, so every agent we ship is measurable and maintainable.

 - Discovery to handover: Take ambiguous business problems from senior leaders, shape them into work worth doing, and make sure what we deliver is something the business can own without us.

Examples of what the squad has already built include a triage agent for incoming support, a tax analysis agent, and an onboarding agent for every new joiner at Xero. Your job is to make sure the squad keeps building the right things, to a consistently high standard.

Impact

 - First 6 months: you'll understand the squad's platform, patterns and stakeholders. You'll be delivering hands-on alongside the team, and you'll have agreed the technical direction and delivery priorities for the squad with Callum. You'll have started coaching the Senior Engineers and be building relationships with executive stakeholders.

 - First 12 months: the squad's patterns and standards will be in use across its workflows, with evals and monitoring as the norm. You'll have led at least one significant agentic workflow into production with an executive partner, and the Senior Engineers around you will be growing in capability and autonomy.

Ownership

You'll own the technical direction of the squad's work, including architecture, standards and the quality bar for what ships. You'll lead the most complex and highest-stakes workflows end to end, from discovery with executive stakeholders through to production and handover. You'll coach and develop Senior Engineers, review their designs and help them grow, and you'll be accountable for outcomes beyond your own code. You'll work with Callum to prioritise the squad's roadmap, and you'll help shape how the squad works, including its use of AI-assisted development.

 - Callum Ochkas, Head of Internal AI. 

 - Executive leaders across Xero's enterprise and G&A functions, including HR, Legal and Finance.

 - Senior Engineers in the Internal AI accelerator squad, who build and run agentic workflows across the business, and who you'll coach.

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and the depth to set technical direction for a squad, including architecture and trade-off decisions

 - Experience delivering agentic AI or LLM workflows into real production use, not just prototypes or personal projects

 - Experience owning relationships with senior non-technical stakeholders, up to executive level: understanding their pain points, building solutions, and handing them over so they run without you

 - Experience designing agentic systems with tool use, retrieval, human-in-the-loop controls and guardrails, and evaluating them with measurable quality criteria

 As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will lead the migration to FleetDM and build the shared platform capabilities that support dependable endpoint operations. - Validate capabilities and coexistence. Identify gaps, clarify management authority, and establish which responsibilities should migrate or remain with existing tools. 

- Make platform health actionable. Establish trustworthy device populations, data freshness, enrollment and agent health, and owned remediation workflows. 

- Protect service continuity. Use representative pilots, acceptance gates, employee-impact checks, and clear pause and recovery decisions. 

- Strengthen team capability. Create reusable patterns, documentation, and shared support coverage through pairing, mentoring, and operational handoffs. 

- Improve efficiency and cost. Reduce recurring manual work and recommend tooling consolidation where evidence supports it. 

 Requirements 

- Significant hands-on experience engineering enterprise endpoint platforms, including deep expertise in at least one of Windows, macOS, or Linux and experience working across OS boundaries. 

- Personal ownership of a multi-phase platform migration or comparable change, including discovery, pilots, rollout, recovery, and operational handover. 

- Strong practical programming or scripting skills, such as Python, Go, PowerShell, or shell, with production automation and API integration experience. 

- Demonstrated use of Git, code review, automated checks, and controlled deployment for configuration or infrastructure changes. 

- Ability to diagnose enrollment, agent, policy, identity, networking, and integration failures and distinguish missing data from healthy devices. 

- Experience establishing monitoring, failure handling, least-privilege access, secrets management, and maintainable operational workflows. 

- Ability to independently define priorities, align cross-functional stakeholders, communicate trade-offs, and mentor engineers. 

- Clear written and verbal communication and effective asynchronous collaboration across regions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Production experience with FleetDM configuration, policies, queries, APIs, agent operations, or deployment automation. 

- Practical osquery and SQL experience, including query validation, performance considerations, targeting, and stale or missing results. 

- Migration or coexistence experience involving Intune, Jamf, or comparable endpoint-management platforms. 

- Experience integrating endpoint platforms with identity, security, inventory, or ITSM services. 

- Experience supporting developer-heavy, distributed environments. 

- Demonstrated improvements in platform operating effort, tool consolidation, or lifecycle cost.

- Adaptability: L earn, adjust, and stay effective through change . 

- Connection: C ommunicat e , collaborat e , and build trust . 

 To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

About the Role

Every team at Xero has work that is slow, manual and error-prone, and the people doing it are often the ones best placed to make better decisions if they had the time. We're building agentic AI workflows that take that toil away, so our people can focus on the work that matters.

The Internal AI accelerator squad partners directly with Xero's enterprise and G&A functions, including HR, Legal and Finance. As Lead Engineer, you'll set the technical direction for the squad as it builds agents and workflows that the business can run itself. You'll stay hands-on in the hardest problems, coach the Senior Engineers around you, and be the senior technical voice with executive leaders across the business.

The Technical Challenges

The squad is early in its life, and the problems are as much about judgement as engineering. Four problems define the work:

 - A repeatable way to build agents: Define the patterns, frameworks and standards the squad uses so each new workflow is faster to build and safer to run than the last.

 - Agents the business trusts: Build agentic workflows that handle real work, with human review, guardrails and clear escalation, so business teams are comfortable relying on them.

 - Production, not prototypes: Set the bar for evals, observability and cost control, so every agent we ship is measurable and maintainable.

 - Discovery to handover: Take ambiguous business problems from senior leaders, shape them into work worth doing, and make sure what we deliver is something the business can own without us.

Examples of what the squad has already built include a triage agent for incoming support, a tax analysis agent, and an onboarding agent for every new joiner at Xero. Your job is to make sure the squad keeps building the right things, to a consistently high standard.

Impact

 - First 6 months: you'll understand the squad's platform, patterns and stakeholders. You'll be delivering hands-on alongside the team, and you'll have agreed the technical direction and delivery priorities for the squad with Callum. You'll have started coaching the Senior Engineers and be building relationships with executive stakeholders.

 - First 12 months: the squad's patterns and standards will be in use across its workflows, with evals and monitoring as the norm. You'll have led at least one significant agentic workflow into production with an executive partner, and the Senior Engineers around you will be growing in capability and autonomy.

Ownership

You'll own the technical direction of the squad's work, including architecture, standards and the quality bar for what ships. You'll lead the most complex and highest-stakes workflows end to end, from discovery with executive stakeholders through to production and handover. You'll coach and develop Senior Engineers, review their designs and help them grow, and you'll be accountable for outcomes beyond your own code. You'll work with Callum to prioritise the squad's roadmap, and you'll help shape how the squad works, including its use of AI-assisted development.

Who You'll Work With

 - Callum Ochkas, Head of Internal AI. 

 - Executive leaders across Xero's enterprise and G&A functions, including HR, Legal and Finance.

 - Senior Engineers in the Internal AI accelerator squad, who build and run agentic workflows across the business, and who you'll coach.

What You Bring

 - Strong software engineering fundamentals and the depth to set technical direction for a squad, including architecture and trade-off decisions

 - Experience delivering agentic AI or LLM workflows into real production use, not just prototypes or personal projects

 - Experience owning relationships with senior non-technical stakeholders, up to executive level: understanding their pain points, building solutions, and handing them over so they run without you

 - Experience coaching and developing engineers, and raising the capability of a team through reviews, standards and mentoring

 - Experience designing agentic systems with tool use, retrieval, human-in-the-loop controls and guardrails, and evaluating them with measurable quality criteria

 - The ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to executives and build trust through delivery

 - Comfort using AI tools to improve how you and your team build, with judgement about when and how to validate their output

How We Work

We're bold in our vision and pragmatic in execution. We deliver useful improvements early and often, and we invest in AI to learn faster and focus effort on higher-value problems. Engineers stay accountable for what they ship, including quality and reliability. We use shared frameworks to avoid reinvention, leaving teams room to innovate. Leaders set context and priorities, and engineers help shape the solutions.

Where We Work

We offer a hybrid model that blends the flexibility of working from home with the collaboration of the office, including designated boost days in our modern office spaces.

Our Hiring Process

 1. TX phone screen (45 minutes): a conversation with your Talent Specialist about your background, motivations and the role.

 2. Round 1 (60 minutes): a technical conversation with the hiring team, where you'll walk through an agentic workflow you've delivered, from the business problem to production.

 3. Round 2 (60 minutes): a conversation focused on how you work with senior stakeholders and show up against Xero's values, including ownership, customer thinking and AI fluency.

 4. LEADership (60 minutes): real examples of how you lead, coach and influence, assessed against Xero's leadership principles.

If this sounds like a role you are interested in, hit the apply button!

• Good communication skills
• Highly skilled problem solver
• Exhibits a high degree of initiative

Nice to have:
• Graduate degree in CS, Data Science, Machine Learning, AI or a related STEM field
• Data Engineering Experience
• Experience with Java
• Experience with Jenkins
• Experience in with data engineering on petabyte scale data
• Understands and implements methods to evaluate own work and others for error
• Loves working with error-prone, messy, disparate, unstructured data

jobs.jd:
A BOUT TIDE 

 At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

 Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

 Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

 Tide facts: 

- Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs

- Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing

- Over $300 million raised in funding

- 3,000 Tideans globally

- We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

About The Team

 The Data Platform Engineering team builds the platform that Tide's data producers and consumers rely on: backend engineers, data engineers, data scientists and, increasingly, AI agents. We own how data is produced, moved, stored, modelled, governed and served across the UK, EU and India, on GCP with BigQuery at the core.

 Our mission is to make the right way the easy way: self-service capabilities with quality, security and cost controls built into the infrastructure, judged by whether teams choose to adopt them, not whether we mandate them.

About The Role

 As Lead Engineer, Data Platform, you will be a hands-on individual contributor who leads platform initiatives within a clear technical direction set by the Data Infrastructure team. You will own small-medium platform initiatives and quarterly goals, taking them from design through to shipping and running them in production, and you will work closely with the Data Infrastructure Engineering Manager and the wider platform team.

In this role you will

- Design and deliver self-service paths so engineers can onboard new sources, datasets and pipelines without a ticket queue, with access, masking, quality and cost controls defined in infrastructure as code and CI/CD.

- Improve ingestion and transformation capabilities so data is fresher and more reliable, handling ordering, duplicates, late data, deletes, replay and backfill, and migrate pipelines without breaking downstream tables.

- Apply governance in what you build: residency, PII masking, least-privilege and just-in-time access, retention and erasure, and lineage.

- Set SLOs, freshness and quality checks, and alerting that tells on-call what matters.

- Find the main cost drivers in data platforms and pipelines, and add guardrails and attribution that teams can act on.

- Break work into phases that ship, with clear milestones, a migration path and a way to measure adoption.

- Use AI-assisted development to build and run the platform faster, and help prepare governed, well-described data that agents can use safely.

- Treat internal engineers as customers: write clear documentation and golden paths, and act on their feedback.

- Review designs and code for other engineers, and raise the bar for production-grade data and API work.

What We Are Looking For

 Tide is looking for a hands-on Lead Engineer to deliver platform initiatives end to end and raise the quality of our data platform. We value what you have shipped and operated over job titles or team size. The ideal candidate will have:

- Independently designed, shipped and operated a meaningful platform or data infrastructure initiative used by internal engineering teams.

- Solid data engineering fundamentals: batch and streaming ingestion, CDC and event-driven patterns, data modelling, and correctness (idempotency, ordering, late data, backfill).

- Strong production engineering in Python and SQL, including building and operating APIs, pipelines or shared libraries.

- Observability for data pipelines: freshness and quality checks, SLOs, alert thresholds and incident response.

- The ability to justify technology choices against requirements, with an order-of-magnitude view of cost and capacity.

- Hands-on use of AI-assisted development with sound engineering judgement. Experience enabling AI tooling for engineering teams is highly preferred.

- Nice to have: experience with global, decentralised teams, and in financial services or other regulated environments.

OUR TECH STACK

 Our data platform runs on GCP: BigQuery as our warehouse, Fivetran and event-driven ingestion, dbt, Apache Airflow (AWS MWAA), Looker, Atlan, Databricks, Terraform, GitHub, ConductorOne and Okta, Coralogix, and Claude for AI-assisted development. - Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.

- Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.

- Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.

- Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accid

Role purpose
 You'll build cloud-native services and user interfaces for a multi-year programme modernizing a large portfolio of middle-office applications and moving them to AWS. This is a hands-on development role with a strong back-end focus. You'll design and build Java microservices and APIs on AWS, and also contribute to ReactJS/TypeScript front ends. You'll use AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Devin every day to deliver faster, while staying fully accountable for the quality and security of the code.

Key responsibilities
 Back-end development (primary) 
 
- Design and build Java/Spring Boot microservices and REST APIs for trade processing, accounting, reconciliation and settlement functions.

- Build event-driven integrations with Kafka and IBM MQ , including message design, error handling, retries and idempotency.

- Write efficient data access against Oracle (JPA/Hibernate and SQL), working with database engineers on schema design and performance.

- Rebuild legacy business logic as clean, testable services, working with business analysts and subject-matter experts to confirm behaviour.

- Write unit, integration and contract tests, and help with performance and resilience testing.
 AWS 
 
- Build and deploy services on AWS : ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, SQS/SNS, RDS, CloudWatch and IAM.

- Design services for scalability, high availability and security, following AWS Well-Architected principles.

- Work with DevOps on Terraform, Docker and CI/CD pipelines (Harness/GitHub Actions) so your services deploy automatically.
 Front-end development (secondary) 
 
- Build and maintain ReactJS/TypeScript screens and components for data-heavy enterprise applications that replace legacy desktop UIs.

- Connect front ends to back-end APIs, handling authentication (SSO/MFA), state management and error handling.

- Write maintainable JavaScript/TypeScript and component tests (Jest/React Testing Library).
 AI-assisted development 
 
- Use GitHub Copilot for inline code completion, chat-based refactoring, test generation and pull-request summaries.

- Use Claude Code for agentic, multi-file work in the terminal: understanding unfamiliar codebases, refactoring across modules, generating tests and fixing failing builds.

- Work with Devin (or similar autonomous agents) on well-defined tasks: write clear task specs, review its pull requests and correct its output.

- Use AI to analyse legacy code (Java EE, Sybase SQL, PowerBuilder, COBOL) and draft specs for subject-matter experts to confirm.

- Write good prompts and context files (e.g. README files, coding standards, agent instruction files) so AI tools produce code that follows team standards.

- Review all AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance and licence compliance before merging. You stay accountable for every line.

- Share effective prompts, patterns and lessons learned with the team.

- Take part in code reviews, design discussions and agile ceremonies.

- Support production releases, cutovers and early-life support, and fix issues quickly.

- Follow State Street secure coding, information security, data classification and approved-AI-tool policies.

- 6+ years in software development, mostly on the back end.

- Java: strong in Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Data/JPA, REST API design and multithreading.

- AWS: good hands-on knowledge of core services (ECS/EKS or Lambda, S3, SQS/SNS, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch).

- Databases: strong SQL; experience with Oracle or another enterprise relational database.

- ReactJS/TypeScript/JavaScript: good working knowledge of React hooks, component design, TypeScript and modern JavaScript (ES6+).

- AI tools: proven, regular use of at least one of GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or Devin in professional delivery, including the ability to judge when AI output is wrong.

- Engineering practices: Git, CI/CD, Docker, automated testing (JUnit, Mockito) and clean code principles.

- Experience working in agile delivery teams.
 
Preferred
 
- Hands-on experience with all three of GitHub Copilot, Claude Code and Devin, and a view on which tool suits which task.

- Experience with MCP servers or giving AI agents context from Jira, Confluence or code repositories.

- Experience in financial services, ideally investment servicing or middle-office areas (trade lifecycle, settlement, collateral, reconciliation or accounting).

- Experience modernizing legacy applications (e.g. Java EE/EJB on Payara or WebSphere, Sybase).

- Experience with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code.

- AWS Developer Associate or Solutions Architect certification.
 
Success measures (first 12 months)
 
- Delivered production-ready services and front-end features for modernized applications, on schedule.

- Services meet agreed standards for test coverage, performance, security and observability.

- Measurable productivity gains from AI tools (e.g. cycle time, test coverage), with no rise in defects or rework.

- Contributed reusable prompts, agent instructions or patterns that the wider team uses.

- Became a trusted contributor in design and code reviews across the team.

 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

 Engineering at Brex 

 Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration, own outcomes end to end, and push for excellence from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft and builders grow by solving meaningful technical problems.

 What you’ll do 

 The Identity and Access Management team builds and maintains secure, user-friendly authentication and authorization systems that protect users, safeguard company assets, and provide a seamless access experience for developers. The team owns critical platform capabilities including login methods, step-up authentication, our custom authorization platform, account delegation flows like Copilot, Pro Access login, embedded partnerships authentication, and core vendor integrations.

 As a Staff Engineer on IAM, you will lead projects and initiatives to improve the security, reliability, and developer experience of our authentication, authorization, and identity platforms for customers, partners, and internal systems. You will scope and drive projects with clear impact, work cross-functionally with the broader engineering organization, help define the team’s technical quality, and help evolve the identity platform as Brex invests in signed identity propagation, delegated and agent identity, fine-grained authorization, stronger auditability, and enterprise-ready customer authentication experiences.

 Where you’ll work 

 This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require Monday, Wednesday and Thursday to be designated in office days. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

 Responsibilities 

- Design, build, and operate backend systems and APIs for authentication, authorization, identity context, and audit-related workflows.

- Lead engineers across the organization on initiatives end to end, from technical design and implementation through rollout, measurement, and operational support.

- Improve login and access experiences across SSO, MFA, step-up authentication, delegated access, and enterprise identity flows.

- Build and extend authorization systems that support custom roles, resource-aware access control, and secure defaults for product teams.

- Lead creation of durable, identity-aware audit trails and attribution for user, service, delegated, and agent-driven actions.

- Partner closely with engineers across Brex to make IAM integrations secure by default and easier to adopt through clear patterns, tooling, and shared libraries.

- Mentor engineers on the team to deliver high-quality code and produce operational improvements that raise the bar for reliability and maintainability across the team’s systems.

 Requirements 

- You have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building reliable production backend systems.

- You have experience leading complex projects and mentoring other engineers.

- You have strong API design fundamentals, rigor around testing, code quality, and documentation.

- You understand core IAM concepts such as authentication, authorization, sessions, tokens, MFA, SSO, OAuth, SAML, OIDC, or RBAC.

- You communicate clearly, collaborate well across teams, and are effective in cross-functional technical discussions.

- You care about operational excellence and know how to improve system reliability, reduce toil, and maintain high-quality services over time.

- You have strong product and engineering judgment and can balance security, usability, and developer experience.

 Bonus points

SaaS Onboarding -Systems Engineer & Automation - AVP 
 Charles River Development is an award-winning provider of software and services to the Investments/Financial Services industry. Our client base includes many of the world’s largest investment and financial institutions. To better serve the growing demand for our Software as a managed service offering.
 This is an internal process improvement, business and technical staff position responsible for managing and supporting as an Assistant Vice President (AVP) of Systems & Automation, the candidate will work as conduit within our financial technology ecosystem working with platform engineering, product, SaaS implementation teams. This is not a "maintenance" role; the candidate is expected to be an agent of change. Candidate will scrutinize our existing manual workflows, identify structural gaps, and build the automated bridges necessary to ensure seamless, secure, and rapid software delivery implementing standard SaaS strategy. This AVP position grants the authority to challenge the status quo. The candidate will not just be using the tools but will be working and deciding how to roll out certain functionality on the SaaS platform.
 Responsibilities: 
 
- Audit existing manual processes across the application lifecycle and design/implement automated solutions to eliminate toil.

- Develop and maintain robust configuration management scripts using Ansible, Python & PowerShell.

- Work with product/engineering teams to optimize the CI/CD pipelines to support rapid, risk-mitigated deployments of CRIMS applications.

- Responsible for ensuring efficiency, availability and configuration of the “CRD Development” SaaS platform by providing solutions based on sound technical knowledge.

- Adopt, customize and implement industry standard DevOps policies and DevOps procedures.

- Create and maintain automated scripts/tools that will build, configure, deploy and test applications deployed to different environments, maintain, support, and enhance continuous integration environments.

- Work hands on with the system, installing and configuring it and testing that it meets the product’s technical and business requirements.

- Work with an automated release management process for SaaS clients.

- Break down moderately complex processes into simple and reliable components.

- Proven ability to work autonomously, taking a project from "identified gap" to "automated solution" without constant supervision.
 
 Requirements: 

- Experience in DevOps (or related) technologies.

- Knowledge of proficient scripting language using Python or any other object-oriented technologies is must.

- Experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Artifactory, JFrog, Git is mandatory.

- Experience with the following is must: Web technologies, databases, server operating systems, servers, networks, job scheduling software, system monitoring software, clusters/high availability systems, Disaster Recovery/Business Continuity etc.

- Experience or familiarity with servers and networks is preferred. NoSQL experience is a plus.

- Experience with SQL, MS SQL, Oracle Server, PostgreSQL preferred.

- Understanding Infrastructure as Service cloud providers such Azure, AWS and Oracle cloud is an advantage.

- Knowledge of web technologies and ability to write REST API in python with web framework is advantage.

- Ability to use a wide variety of open-source technologies and cloud services.

- Experience and knowledge in network protocols (e.g. WINS, DNS, TCP/IP, WinRM, ssh, SFTP, SMTP)

- Experience with automation, using scripting and tools like Ansible, Puppet, Chef, RunDeck is added advantage.
 Qualifications: 
 
- Experience: 5+ years in a DevOps, Automation Engineer, or Systems Engineering role, preferably within the Financial Services or Banking sector.
 
- Bachelor’s Degree in technical discipline such as Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, MIC/CIS, etc.

- Understanding of financial application logic and the regulatory rigors of banking production environments.

 Salary Range:

This globally-distributed team of expert engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene.  Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.

-

-

-

-

-

The team

The team works together to balance automation, performance, operational health, and deployment pipelines, maintaining a strong focus on security and data guidelines. By promoting Xero-wide quality standards and creating an inclusive environment, everyone connects to ensure high-performing and reliable outcomes.

 - Promoting Xero-wide quality standards, guiding teams in defining SLOs, and ensuring security guidelines are embedded across systems.

 - Shaping frameworks to quantify technical debt and proactively preventing production issues through robust tooling.

 - Proven experience leading large, complex technical initiatives on cloud-native platforms, with a focus on scaling performance and reliability.

Apply even if your experience isn’t a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

 Engineering at Brex 

 Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration, own outcomes end to end, and push for excellence from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft and builders grow by solving meaningful technical problems.

 What you’ll do 

 As a Senior GRC Engineer at Brex, you’ll lead the IT security compliance workstreams that connect our technical control owners to the people who examine our controls: external auditors, Internal Audit, state regulators, and Finance. You’ll coordinate and test the technical controls behind our financial reporting (SOX/ITGC), our annual SOC 1 Type 2 report, our state money transmitter examinations, and our FINRA IT requirements. You’ll also run the annual business continuity and disaster recovery (BC/DR) testing calendar.

 As part of the GRC team you may also contribute to the following operational tasks:

- Third party risk management 

- Risk register maintenance and reporting

- Customer Trust / GTM due diligence support

- Tooling access requests

- Assist with requests related to other certifications like SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, or ISO 27001

 Where you’ll work 

 This role will be based in our New York City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

 Responsibilities 

- Lead IT SOX/ITGC test procedures, walkthroughs, evidence, workpapers, and remediation across logical access, change management, computer operations, and IT governance.

- Manage our annual SOC 1 Type 2 engagement, including external auditor coordination, control descriptions, evidence, deficiency tracking, and review of draft report sections.

- Support state money transmitter (MTL) examinations by working with Legal, Compliance, and Finance on IT documentation, examiner requests, and tracking of IT findings.

- Test quarterly user access reviews, privileged-access evidence, and segregation-of-duties remediation, and verify that in-scope changes are complete and properly authorized.

- Run the annual BC/DR testing calendar, including tabletop and failover exercises, and document results, evidence, and remediation.

- Prepare FINRA-related IT control documentation, including business continuity, books-and-records, systems access reviews, and readiness testing.

- Track findings through to closure with clear control owners, deadlines, and evidence, and keep audit coordination separate from control operation.

- Support broader GRC team operational tasks related to evidence collection, access requests, and risk management.

 Requirements 

- 5+ years of experience in IT audit, SOX/ITGC testing, GRC, or technology compliance, in fintech, financial services, or public accounting.

- Hands-on experience with ITGC testing across logical access, change management, and computer operations, and with documenting results in audit workpapers.

- Working knowledge of SOC 1 / SSAE 18, including Type 2 reports, control descriptions, and deficiency management.

- Familiarity with PCAOB standards.

- Experience working with external auditors, regulators, or examiners and responding to their requests on deadline.

- Strong organization and project management skills, with the ability to run several audit workstreams on different calendars at once.

- Clear communication, and comfort holding technical control owners accountable for evidence and remediation.

 Bonus points 

- CISA, CIA, CPA, or CISSP certification.

- Experience with state money transmitter examinations or FINRA IT and books-and-records requirements.

- Experience coordinating BC/DR testing, including tabletop and failover exercises.

- Experience supporting audit readiness during an acquisition or integration.

- Familiarity with COSO 2013 and COBIT.

- Experience with GRC or audit workflow tools, or with SQL or scripting for control testing.

 Compensation 

 The expected salary range for this role is $173,568 - $238,656 . However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

 Brex LLC is a wholly owned subsidiary of Capital One, N.A.
